Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Strategy & Operations Associate

Ops is the thread that runs through everything at Taktile. As we enter our next phase of growth, we are professionalizing how the company operates, so we can grow fast without losing focus or quality. That's where you come in.

As our Strategy & Operations Associate, you will sit at the center of the company's growth story. This is a hands-on, high-trust role for someone who wants to learn company-building from the inside, move fast, and see their impact on the business within days. You will become part of the company's highest-leverage projects, surrounded by people who expect excellence and care about building something that lasts.

What you will do

  • You come in wherever needed to help us move fast - one week this could mean helping with all hands messaging, FDE hiring and introducing new AI-enabled processes, the other week this could mean working on pricing strategy, creating competition battle cards or establishing new partnerships

  • Know the org inside out: understand how we work, prioritize, and measure success - and proactively improve our ops by partnering with teams across the whole company - e.g., Strategy & Operations, GTM, Product, and G&A

  • Help shape and evolve our long-term operating model, acting as a force multiplier across the leadership team - owning key operating cadences & cross-functional alignments

Your Profile

  • You are hungry to build and get energy from moving fast

  • You move fluidly between big-picture strategy and the operational detail that makes it real

  • You like to get your hands dirty — you solve problems hands-on, not just in a slide deck

  • You're a structured thinker — you take messy, complex problems and turn them into a clear plan others rally behind

  • You're AI-native — you reach for AI tools instinctively to move faster and think sharper

  • You're a clear, concise communicator with high ownership — people trust you to run with things and deliver

  • 1-2 of experience in strategy, consulting, or a fast-scaling startup

What We Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About Taktile

Taktile enables banks and insurers to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions — approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, and financing every business worth funding.

Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Pleo, Monzo, and Faire. With offices in New York, London, Berlin, São Paulo, and Iași, we've raised $184M from Goldman Sachs Growth Equity, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com

About Your Employment. Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process.

Your Privacy. Taktile (“we” or “us”) is the controller of the personal data you provide during this application process. We collect and process your name, contact details, resume/CV, work history, education, and any other information you submit or that we obtain from publicly available sources or references.

California residents have additional rights under the CCPA, including the right to know, delete, and correct personal information.

Automated decision-making: We use automated tools to assist in screening applications. No hiring decision is made solely by automated means without human review.

title: Alpha Plant Systems Lead
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

YOUR IMPACT

Shape the architecture of the world’s first net energy gain stellarator by taking full responsibility for the design, integration, and delivery of Alpha’s ancillary systems. You will own the system-level decisions that determine how breakthrough technology is integrated and delivered.

Taking accountability for the tritium fuel cycle, high voltage electrical power, heating sources, cryogenic and non-cryogenic cooling systems, and waste water treatment, you will also take total ownership of the complexity between them and the stellarator: the piping, distribution networks, and critical infrastructure that connect them. You will lead the team of teams translating the needs of Alpha into the physical delivery of major ancillaries, bridging in-house talent and external contractors.

Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in industry: this role demands deep, hands-on technical judgement and the ability to make impactful design decisions across a wide range of tightly coupled disciplines to turn cutting-edge science into a functioning facility.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Drive integrated system design and delivery: Own the integrated design of the ancillary systems and all interconnecting infrastructure to seamlessly embed them into the wider Alpha facility.

  • Modernize the engineering approach: Bring a forward-thinking vision to the industrial facility development process by including, for example, advanced process engineering techniques, modern Building Information Modeling (BIM), and 4D assembly planning.

  • Own the interfaces and the budget: Manage complex trade-offs and resolve critical design constraints by collaborating closely with stellarator engineering and facility teams. You will own the budget for these systems and serve as the primary technical interface with external stakeholders and regulatory bodies.

  • Build systems with a fast-moving team: Combine systems thinking with a pragmatic execution mindset. You will lead across the ancillary systems, providing the judgement needed to unblock cross-system challenges and facility trade decisions.

  • Execute safe and successful operations: Define the safety logic and lead the integrated installation, commissioning, and maintenance strategies for Alpha’s ancillary systems.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • End-to-End Infrastructure Delivery: A proven track record owning major projects, from design through to construction, commissioning, and handover.

  • Relevant Industrial Experience: First-hand experience witnessing and delivering complex plant engineering and facilities. Broad backgrounds that are relevant for this role include manufacturing, data centers, refineries, chemical plants, or industrial gas production.

  • Deep Technical and Design Judgement: Strong technical skillsets beyond delivery management with the ability to lead design decisions regarding complex facility integration.

  • Systems & Execution Mindset: The ability to balance inputs from multidisciplinary technical teams and a bias to action in resolving critical trade-offs.

  • Agility and Leadership: Team players who thrive in fast moving, high growth environments. Demonstrated ability to manage large internal and external work packages.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-45 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30 min)

Successful applicants will be assigned to one of the Engineering teams within Proxima, depending on their specific skills, location, and the needs of the organisation.

This role sits at L4 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

  • Own the value case: set the baseline at go-live, track it, and defend it in the quarterly business review.

  • Be the first point of escalation for your clients. Call a delivery review when a project is off track, require a recovery plan, and hold the organization to it.

  • Identify expansion early, new entities, new processes, new countries, and build the internal case for it.

  • Be the voice of your customers inside blp: collect and structure product feedback from your accounts, and work with Product, Engineering and Sales to translate what clients need into what gets built, without losing sight of blp's own product direction.

Client Partners work closest to our leadership and to our largest customers. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Career Path in Consulting

Our Consulting team has a clear path, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the impact you have had, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • AI Automation Specialist: Hands-on in the automation itself: you tune agents, run automation sprints and take your first own customers end to end. Typically you bring up to 2 years of experience.

  • Consultant: You own a portfolio of live customers as their run lead, including health, growth and account economics. Typically you bring 3+ years in consulting, process improvement or ERP process ownership.

  • Senior Consultant: Our most complex and sensitive accounts, at executive level, and you coach the Consultants and Specialists around you. Typically you bring several years of leading process change at customers.

  • Next steps: Lead a Consulting team, or become a Client Partner on our strategic accounts.

Moves into Project Management or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Your Mission

For a process to run autonomously, four things have to line up: the technology, the process itself, the data behind it, and the people who work with it. That alignment does not happen at go-live. It happens in the months after, and that is where our Consulting team sits.

Our customers go live with a working solution. What they do not have on day one is an organization that operates in an AI-native way. Processes were designed around people checking things. Data was maintained well enough for humans to interpret. Teams know the old workarounds better than the new system. Our job is to lead that transition, from a process that is automated in parts to a process that genuinely runs on its own.

This is also where our AI meets the real world, and the real world is messy. When a customer goes live, our agents start processing their documents: invoices, order confirmations, delivery notes, in dozens of formats from thousands of suppliers, with layouts nobody has seen before. Most of it works immediately. The rest is where we come in.

A concrete example. Our AI learns a customer's business logic from their own history. By reading how they have accounted invoices in the past, blp infers the rules they have been applying and makes them explicit. Sometimes it cannot close the loop on its own, because the same kind of invoice was historically booked in two or three different ways and there is no consistent rule to find. In those cases blp asks. It needs the answer once, and every future case follows it. Making sure that answer arrives, and that it is the right one, is our job. Done well, each of those conversations builds trust and removes a category of manual work permanently.

As an AI Automation Specialist

You are hands-on in the automation itself. You configure and tune the agents so they work for a specific customer, dig into exceptions until you find the actual cause rather than patching the symptom, and run automation sprints: the push after each go-live to the target automation rate, and focused sprints our customers book to take their automation further.

You are in front of customers from early on: running the sessions that explain what a new capability does, taking the open questions our AI raises to the person who can decide them, and chasing down why automation is not landing, whether that is a master data problem, a habit, or a process rule that no longer makes sense. You use data-driven insights to decide which conversations to have with customers and which improvements to prioritize.

You work alongside a Consultant on your accounts and build process and platform depth on real customers from the first month.

Key Responsibilities

Automation and performance

  • Configure and tune agents so they work for a specific customer's documents and processes.

  • Drive and own the push after each go-live, from first live volume to the target automation rate, and deliver the automation sprints our customers book.

  • Resolve the open questions our AI raises about a customer's business logic: take the cases to the customer, get the decision, and make it permanent.

  • Drill into root causes when automation stalls, and tell a master data problem from a process rule from a behavior.

Customer health and growth

  • Own customer health across your portfolio, measured first and foremost by automation rates.

  • Act as run lead and escalation point for your customers once they are live.

  • Challenge process rules that prevent automation, and drive improvements with the department leads who can decide.

  • Enable the customer's core team to resolve issues themselves, and reduce what has to come to us at all.

  • Spot expansion opportunities and bring in Sales, and work alongside the Client Partner on strategic accounts.

Account economics

  • Secure and monitor service consumption against the agreed budgets.

  • Scope automation sprints and additional services, and make sure paid work is billed.

Team and platform

  • Work with our Customer Success Engineers on technical topics, and feed recurring patterns back to Product.

  • As a Consultant, direct the AI Automation Specialists working on your accounts.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this team:

  • Process Excellence – You understand core business processes, P2P and O2C, and you can see why a process is shaped the way it is and what it could look like instead.

  • Client Hands – You bring customers with you. You are strict on the things that matter and flexible on the things that do not.

  • Pattern Recognition – You notice that thirty exceptions are really one problem.

  • Comfort in the Data – You go into the numbers yourself to find where automation is leaking.

  • Ownership – You see a job through, and you take a customer from live to high automation without being told the steps.

  • Growth Mindset – You learn fast, ask when you are stuck, and get better every month.

What You Bring

For the AI Automation Specialist level

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. Strong career changers are equally welcome.

  • Up to 2 years of professional experience. Internships, working student roles or a first analytical job count.

  • Structured, analytical way of working and solid command of Excel or equivalent.

At every level

  • Confident in front of customers, from operational teams to their leadership.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for experience with ERP systems, accounts payable or order management processes, data skills such as SQL or Python, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. As part of our unified global ads organization across Deliveroo and Wolt (DoorDash International), our Product team defines how millions of people experience the marketplace, turning complex logistics and advertising challenges into simple, high-impact solutions. Working at the intersection of data, design, and engineering, we set the direction for the world's leading merchant-funded marketing engine. You will lead outcomes that scale our ads and promotions business while protecting marketplace integrity and the consumer experience.

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our London team. In this role, you'll drive key pillars of our global strategy, leading initiatives to drive growth for our merchant and brand advertiser audiences.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a high-velocity team working on DoorDash International's most critical growth levers. You will collaborate with Engineering, Data Science, and global GTM teams to build a unified retail media platform that serves our three-sided marketplace.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Set the overall strategy for the next set of growth products that we'll build for our global audience of merchants and brands.
  • Optimizing ad supply and relevance through improved ranking algorithms and inventory designs.
  • Building a path towards a global technology stack, so product innovations reach all markets instantly.
  • Running experiments to gather data, understand customer outcomes, and measure the impact of your bets.
  • Talking with customers to understand their needs and plan the next series of strategic investments we'll make to drive their success

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others: 
  • Proven experience as a Product Manager with experience from the B2B/B2C and/or Adtech and Martech space - you know what it takes to develop great products
  • Significant experience being data-savvy and analytical; you can grasp technical concepts quickly and partner effectively with
  • Machine Learning and Operations Research specialists.
  • A systems-thinking mindset, with the ability to balance customer needs with commercial goals while considering second and third-order effects on the marketplace.
  • Demonstrated ownership of high-velocity execution, maintaining a sharp eye for detail in an environment where impact is paramount.
  • Resilience to thrive in a high-ownership environment where you are empowered to make formal ship decisions.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning. 💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

title: Technical Program Manager (Science)
description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.



The Role

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking a Technical Program Manager with a strong technical or scientific background (Natural Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering and/or AI/ML) to join our team in Cambridge or London. You will be a key driver of technical cohesion, bridging the gap between our research and the physical implementation of next-generation materials.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building and executing the program management framework that accelerates cutting-edge scientific research and tool/model development, which is critical for translating scientific objectives into real-world, scalable materials breakthroughs.

As a member of our growing team of TPMs, you will work closely with our internal technical teams on coordinating complex scientific campaigns and also manage scoping and delivery of high-stakes customer projects. You will also be involved in establishing more sophisticated, scalable processes for model development lifecycles and improvements to end to end technical delivery.


What You Will Do

Program Leadership & Research Integration

  • Lead internal technical programs across frontier research, AI/ML model development, data workflows, and machine learning infrastructure, acting as the connective tissue between materials scientists, AI researchers and engineers.

  • Translate scientific and business objectives into executable plans, aligning commercial, research and engineering teams.

  • Close the loop between experimental results and the AI research cycle, translating lab findings back into the model development process to continuously improve accuracy and accelerate discovery.

  • Own planning and delivery of projects; calculating compute, managing resources & dependencies, mapping out timelines, and managing risks to ensure successful outcomes.

Partner & Customer Collaboration

  • Lead technical programs with industry partners and research institutions, serving as a primary program contact for our external partners during the execution and delivery of projects.

  • Facilitate technical discussions between internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Drive project scoping and proposal writing in collaboration with the partnerships and technical teams.

  • Manage joint development initiatives and coordinate customer pilot programs from conception through to deployment.

Process & Operations

  • Work closely with the rest of the global TPM team to refine scalable processes.

  • Implement metrics for tracking technical milestones and program outcomes.

  • Coordinate compliance and regulatory considerations across programs.

  • Support intellectual property (IP) and scientific publication processes.

  • Foster interdisciplinary team culture and own change management to successfully scale the organisation.

  • Use data to drive continuous improvements to internal and customer facing processes.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You possess a strong background in a Natural Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or related field.

  • Proven experience as a Technical Program Manager in a scientific or AI/ML environment, with a clear sense of where the opportunities and challenges in the field lie.

  • Technical fluency across model architecture, cloud infrastructure, and the software development lifecycle.

  • Strong leadership and facilitation capabilities for managing cross-functional teams.

  • The ability to navigate high levels of ambiguity and maintain cohesion across multi-disciplinary teams (AI, Chemistry, and Engineering).

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both highly technical researchers and non-technical partners at varying levels of seniority.

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with comfort navigating ambiguity and changing priorities.

  • Experience managing technical external-facing customer projects.


Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Practical experience or an academic background in Materials Science, Experimental Chemistry, or Physics.

  • Hands-on experience with high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure or scientific data management.

  • Experience with molecular simulation software, quantum chemistry packages, or cheminformatics tools.

Additional Considerations

This role will be based in our London or Cambridge office, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations (Amsterdam and Berlin) for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

As a Staff Engineer at Checkout.com, you will set the technical direction for systems that process payments at very high throughput, where correctness matters on every single transaction and has significant impact. This is a role for engineers who are energised by scale and by the hard trade-offs that come with it: latency budgets, failure domains, consistency guarantees, and the operational reality of running critical infrastructure around the clock.

You will operate as a force multiplier across multiple teams - shaping architecture, raising the engineering bar, and turning ambiguous, business-critical problems into designs that can be delivered incrementally. We're looking for individuals with deep technical judgement, strong ownership, and a pragmatic approach to breaking big problems into smaller iterations that deliver value continuously.

How you'll make an impact

  • Own the architecture of high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems, defining the service boundaries, data models and integration patterns that let them scale by an order of magnitude

  • Design for resilience from first principles - redundancy, graceful degradation, backpressure, idempotency and recovery - so that partial failures never become customer-facing outages

  • Set and defend the non-functional requirements that matter: availability targets, latency percentiles, throughput ceilings, data durability and recovery objectives

  • Lead the hardest technical decisions end to end, from problem framing and design review through to production rollout, migration and decommissioning of what came before

  • Drive operational excellence by improving observability, alerting, capacity planning, load and chaos testing, and incident response, and by closing the loop on the root causes you find

  • Raise the engineering bar across teams through design reviews, code review, pairing and mentorship, growing the senior engineers around you

  • Partner with product, platform and other engineering teams to sequence delivery, remove blockers and keep multi-team programmes aligned on a single technical direction

  • Make pragmatic build-versus-buy and refactor-versus-rewrite calls, and communicate the reasoning and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and senior leadership

Experience and qualifications

  • Significant experience building and operating distributed backend systems in production, with a track record of technical leadership across multiple teams

  • Demonstrable experience designing for high throughput and low latency, and a strong intuition for where systems break under load

  • Deep understanding of resilience patterns in distributed systems: idempotency, retries and backoff, circuit breaking, queueing and backpressure, consistency and failure modes

  • Strong proficiency in either .NET or Java, and the ability to write clear, production-ready code that others can maintain

  • Experience with event-driven and streaming architectures, and with relational and non-relational data stores at scale

  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based application development (we use AWS & Azure), containers, orchestration and infrastructure as code

  • Experience owning production systems on call, with a strong sense of ownership for observability, monitoring and incident response

  • Experience leading complex migrations or re-architectures of live, business-critical systems with no loss of availability or data integrity

  • Excellent communication skills, able to influence without authority, write clear design documents, and express technical trade-offs to engineering and non-technical audiences alike

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in payments, financial services or another domain with strict correctness, auditability or regulatory requirements

  • Experience with multi-region or active-active architectures, including data replication and failover strategies

  • A history of mentoring engineers into senior and staff-level roles

Additional Information

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

description:
Senior Network Developer

About Share

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months.

Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served.

The Role

Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices.

You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team.

What you'll do

  • Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time.

  • Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist.

  • Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable.

  • Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change.

  • Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop.

  • Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system.

  • Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off.

  • Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP.

  • Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit.

  • Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense.

  • Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you.

  • You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe.

  • You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed.

  • AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't.

  • You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network.

  • A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders.

Nice to have

  • Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale.

  • Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them.

  • Streaming telemetry (gNMI/gRPC, sFlow), and building your own monitoring tooling.

  • 400G/800G and optical (ZR) deployments, including vendor selection and certification.

  • Access networks (GPON/XGS-PON) and MikroTik or Huawei gear, since many partner ISPs run it.

  • Building networks in emerging markets such as Africa or Latin America.

  • DDoS mitigation at the edge.

If you don't tick every box but have built and run large networks in production, apply anyway.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a venture-backed company (US-incorporated, with a Kenya operating entity)

Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre d'Enseignement, de Recherche et d'Innovation Énergie Environnement (CERI EE) (https://recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr/energie-environnement-ceri/).

Le CERI EE développe des activités au cœur des transitions énergétiques et environnementales. Sa recherche est orientée vers les sciences de l'atmosphère, la qualité des environnements intérieurs et les enjeux de l'efficacité énergétique et de la décarbonation. Le CERI est structuré en trois axes thématiques : EFT (Énergie, Fluides et Transferts), OSPA (Observations, Sources et Processus physico-chimiques Atmosphériques) et QEI (Qualité des Environnements Intérieurs).

L'axe thématique QEI porte sur l'étude, l'identification et la caractérisation des sources de polluants dans les espaces clos et/ou confinés, l'analyse des interactions entre l'air intérieur et les matériaux, ainsi que l'étude de l'influence des environnements sur l'exposition et le bien-être des occupants. Les enjeux scientifiques traités couvrent plusieurs échelles, depuis l'intégration de matériaux et de systèmes énergétiques innovants jusqu'à leurs impacts sur les espaces intérieurs et leurs occupants. Dans un contexte marqué par le changement climatique et des exigences croissantes en termes de QEI et d'efficacité énergétique, une attention particulière est portée aux stratégies d'adaptation et d'atténuation, ainsi qu'aux rôles du comportement des occupants et des différentes sources d'exposition.

Ce poste vise à renforcer et développer l'axe thématique QEI au sein du CERI. La QEI intègre l'étude de multiples paramètres de confort (température, hygrométrie, bruit, luminosité) et de composition de l'air dans les environnements clos (logements, espaces de travail, transports, etc.), afin d'assurer bien-être et santé des occupants. Ces environnements doivent concilier les transitions environnementales et énergétiques avec la qualité de l'air et le confort des occupants.

L'ambition est de consolider le positionnement d'IMT Nord Europe dans ce domaine, avec une synergie entre recherche et formation. Il s'agit de renforcer un réseau de recherche et d'enseignement interdisciplinaire sur cette thématique en réponse à des attentes sociétales, des pouvoirs publics et des acteurs socio-économiques. Le recrutement s'effectue sur un projet de recherche et d'enseignement porté par un ou une titulaire de doctorat et s'inscrivant dans cette stratégie.

Dans ce cadre, IMT Nord Europe recrute un Enseignant Chercheur ou une Enseignante Chercheuse dont les missions sont décrites ci-après.

MISSIONS :

Sous l'autorité de la directrice du CERI EE, le ou la titulaire du poste participera aux activités d'enseignement, de recherche et de transfert de technologie :

Activités de recherche et de transfert de technologie :

Dans le cadre général de la stratégie scientifique précédemment décrite, les recherches auront pour objectif de développer des connaissances scientifiques et des outils avec pour finalité l'amélioration de la qualité de l'air des environnements intérieurs (en particulier mais de manière non exclusive dans les bâtiments), de la santé, du confort et de l'exposition des occupants tout en accompagnant les transformations du cadre bâti nécessaires à la transition écologique et énergétique.

Les thèmes de recherche attendus pourraient porter sur :

•      La préservation de la QEI face au changement climatique et à la nécessaire adaptation à ce changement ;

•      Les contributions des environnements intérieurs à l'exposition des occupants en intégrant les moyens d'évaluation et d'optimisation de l'exposition et du confort des occupants ;

•      Les impacts de la sobriété énergétique des systèmes énergétiques innovants et durables sur la QEI.

La personne recrutée devra :

•      Développer une activité de recherche de haut niveau dans le domaine de la QEI,

•      Initier, conduire et coordonner des projets de recherche régionaux, nationaux et à terme européens,

•      Développer des actions de recherche contractuelle et de transfert de technologie en partenariat avec des acteurs du monde socio-économique,

•      Créer des passerelles entre les axes thématiques du CERI EE et les autres CERI en lien avec les domaines d'excellence d'IMT Nord Europe et de l'Institut Mines Télécom,

•      Encadrer des doctorants, des post-doctorants et des étudiants de Master,

•      Préparer une Habilitation à Diriger des Recherches,

•      Participer au rayonnement de la thématique en lien étroit avec les autres collègues du CERI, notamment à l'international,

•      Publier dans les conférences et revues de référence du domaine, et participer à l'organisation d'événements scientifiques.

Activités d'enseignement :

Le CERI EE intervient dans l'ensemble des cursus Ingénieur. Il porte notamment deux des huit parcours de spécialité de l'école : GE (Génie Energétique) et GERI (Génie de l'Environnement et Risques Industriels) en formation initiale et une formation en apprentissage en Génie Energétique. Le CERI EE est également porteur de deux Mastères Spécialisés (MS) : le MS Bâtiment à Energie Positive, et le MS en Management des Risques Professionnels et Technologiques. Le CERI EE assure également des activités d'enseignements en formation continue, notamment en lien avec la QEI. Enfin, le CERI EE a pour projet de développer à court terme un projet de Master International « Engineering of Sustainable and Healthy Built Environment » dans lequel la personne recrutée viendra en appui aux personnes en charge du développement de cette formation.

La personne recrutée devra :

•      En lien avec le montage en cours d'un Master International Engineering of Sustainable and Healthy Built Environment, proposer un projet d'enseignement qui viendra, en partie, en appui des pilotes de ce Master pour notamment :

–     Contribuer à la finalisation pédagogique et à la promotion de cette nouvelle formation,

–     Contribuer aux enseignements et tutorats des étudiants du master. En s'appuyant sur l'alliance européenne EuLiST, ce Master vise à aligner activités de recherche et d'enseignement. Ces enseignements devront être dispensés en anglais.

•      Contribuer aux activités d'enseignement dans les différentes formations proposées à l'Ecole, dans son domaine de spécialité (QEI) et dans des domaines connexes (ex : chimie, thermodynamique, ...) en fonction de son champ disciplinaire ;

•      Contribuer aux activités pédagogiques sur l'ensemble des formations portées par IMT Nord Europe, en fonction de ses domaines d'expertise et des besoins pédagogiques ;

•      Contribuer à la mise en place d'innovations pédagogiques intégrant les outils numériques (MOOC, classe inversée, etc.),

•      S'investir dans les activités d'encadrement pédagogique (projets, stages, tutorats) et de sélection (concours).


PROFIL : (Prérequis/ Diplôme)

La personne retenue devra être titulaire d'un doctorat et justifier d'une expérience de recherche dans le domaine de la Qualité des Environnements Intérieurs ou dans une discipline contribuant à son étude, telle que la physico-chimie de l'air intérieur, l'évaluation de l'exposition individuelle, ou encore la performance énergétique et environnementale des bâtiments. Le profil recherché repose avant tout sur de solides compétences expérimentales, complété par une bonne compréhension des enjeux et des outils de simulation de la qualité de l'air intérieur. Ainsi, une aptitude à développer des recherches aux interfaces disciplinaires est recherchée afin d'articuler les problématiques d'exposition et de confort des occupants avec les caractéristiques des bâtiments et les stratégies d'amélioration de leur performance énergétique.

Il est attendu du candidat ou de la candidate de :

•      Démontrer une capacité à appréhender les enjeux multidisciplinaires liés à la QEI, avec une ouverture scientifique permettant d'intégrer des problématiques variées et de travailler aux interfaces disciplinaires ;

•      Faire preuve d'une aptitude à développer de nouvelles compétences dans des champs disciplinaires complémentaires à son profil initial ;

•      Posséder une bonne compréhension des enjeux industriels et sociétaux liés aux thématiques du poste ;

•      Attester d'une activité scientifique de qualité, traduite par des publications dans des revues et conférences à fort impact, idéalement en collaboration avec des équipes internationales ;

•      Présenter, si possible, une expérience dans le montage et la conduite de projets financés sur appels à projets compétitifs, avec obtention de financements externes ou démontrer une aptitude à coordonner des actions collectives ;

•      Montrer une appétence pour la transmission des connaissances et l'enseignement en démontrant si possible une expérience en termes d'innovations pédagogiques (MOOC, enseignement hybride, méthodes actives) ;

•      Faire preuve de compétences organisationnelles et relationnelles de manière à interagir efficacement avec l'ensemble des interlocuteurs (enseignement, recherche, support technique et autres partenaires industriels notamment) ;

•      Faire preuve d'autonomie, d'initiative, d'esprit collectif et d'un sens affirmé du service public ;

•      Disposer de solides compétences en communication scientifique et en vulgarisation, en français comme en anglais.

Une expérience internationale, une participation à des projets collaboratifs ainsi qu'un premier réseau au sein des communautés académiques et/ou industrielles constitueront des atouts appréciés. title: Enseignante Chercheuse ou Enseignant Chercheur (Maître de conférences)  BIM et Performance Durable des Bâtiments en CDI à IMT Nord Europe
description:
INTITULÉ : « BIM et Performance Durable des Bâtiments ».

SPÉCIALITÉS : « Génie civil, BIM, Matériaux de construction durables, Performance des bâtiments ».

ÉTABLISSEMENT D'AFFECTATION :

École Nationale Supérieure Mines-Télécom Lille Douai dont le nom d'usage est IMT Nord Europe.

Direction / Service : Centre d'Enseignement, de Recherche et d'Innovation Matériaux & Procédés (CERI MP)

Responsable hiérarchique : Directeur du CERI Matériaux & Procédés

Catégorie : Agent de catégorie A ou contractuel cadre de gestion de catégorie II

Nature du poste : CDI

Lieu de travail : Site de Douai. Des déplacements sur les autres sites de l'École et auprès des partenaires sont à prévoir

CONTEXTE

École sous tutelle du ministère de l'économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, et école de l'Institut Mines Télécom, IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l'innovation et les créations d'entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l'Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1h30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l'ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l'ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d'enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s'appuie sur plus de 20 000m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d'excellence dans les domaines suivants :

•      Énergie Environnement

•      Systèmes Numériques

•      Matériaux et Procédés

L'École dispose également d'antennes à Dunkerque, Valenciennes et Alençon.

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l'Ecole : www.imt-nord-europe.fr

Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du CERI Matériaux & Procédés (CERI MP), centre de recherche positionné sur le déploiement de nouveaux matériaux et procédés nécessaires aux transitions écologiques et industrielles. Le CERI MP développe notamment des compétences en génie civil, éco-matériaux, économie circulaire, matériaux biosourcés et géosourcés, recyclage, valorisation des déchets, durabilité des matériaux, essais multi-physiques, modélisation et procédés numériques.

Dans un contexte de transformation du secteur de la construction, le BIM constitue un levier majeur pour concevoir, construire, exploiter, réhabiliter et déconstruire les bâtiments de manière plus durable. Le recrutement vise à renforcer l'offre de formation d'IMT Nord Europe dans le domaine du BIM et à développer une activité de recherche originale à l'interface entre la maquette numérique, la connaissance des matériaux, l'éco-conception, l'économie circulaire et la performance globale des bâtiments sur l'ensemble de leur cycle de vie.

Dans ce cadre, IMT Nord Europe recrute un Enseignant Chercheur ou une Enseignante Chercheuse dont les missions sont décrites ci-après.

MISSIONS :

Sous l'autorité du directeur du CERI Matériaux & Procédés, le ou la titulaire du poste aura pour mission de développer des enseignements et des activités de recherche dans le domaine du BIM appliqué aux performances durables des bâtiments. Il ou elle contribuera à former des ingénieurs capables d'utiliser la maquette numérique et les données du bâtiment pour concevoir, optimiser, suivre et améliorer les performances des ouvrages, depuis la phase de conception jusqu'à l'exploitation, la rénovation, la déconstruction et la valorisation des matériaux en fin de vie.

Le poste s'inscrit dans une logique d'intégration formation-recherche-innovation. Il devra permettre de créer un lien fort entre les compétences du CERI MP en matériaux de construction durables, procédés, recyclage et valorisation matière, et les besoins émergents du secteur du bâtiment en matière de BIM, d'openBIM, d'analyse du cycle de vie, de pilotage de la performance et d'aide à la décision.

•      Contribuer au développement et à l'animation des enseignements en BIM, matériaux durables et performance des bâtiments dans les formations d'ingénieur et de master ;

•      Développer une activité de recherche sur l'amélioration des performances des bâtiments sur leur cycle de vie, en intégrant les dimensions matériaux, environnementales, économiques et d'exploitation.

Activités d'enseignement :

La personne recrutée participera aux cours, TD, TP, projets et encadrements dans le parcours Génie Civil Environnement, le DNM ADMODC – Advanced Design and Management of Durable Constructions, ainsi que dans les enseignements liés au BIM, aux matériaux durables et aux performances des bâtiments. Elle pourra également intervenir dans d'autres formations de l'école, en formation initiale, apprentissage ou formation continue, selon les besoins pédagogiques.

•      Concevoir, assurer et faire évoluer des enseignements de niveau ingénieur et master sur les fondamentaux du BIM, la maquette numérique, l'openBIM, l'IFC, la coordination BIM et le management de l'information ;

•      Développer des enseignements appliqués liant BIM, matériaux de construction, éco-conception, analyse du cycle de vie, indicateurs carbone, performance énergétique, performance environnementale et durabilité des ouvrages ;

•      Mettre en place des TD et TP mobilisant : modélisation BIM, extraction et structuration de données, couplage BIM-simulation, BIM-ACV, gestion des informations matériaux, scénarios de rénovation et de fin de vie ;

•      Encadrer des projets intégrateurs permettant aux élèves de travailler en équipe sur un bâtiment réel ou un cas industriel : conception collaborative, choix des matériaux, estimation des impacts, suivi des performances et stratégie de valorisation matière ;

•      Participer à l'encadrement de stages, projets de fin d'études, alternants, projets de recherche et travaux d'étudiants en lien avec les entreprises et les plateformes expérimentales du CERI MP ;

•      Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des maquettes pédagogiques, à l'approche par compétences et à la cohérence avec les attendus de la formation d'ingénieur.

Activités de recherche et de transfert de technologie :

La personne recrutée développera, au sein du CERI MP, une activité de recherche portant sur l'amélioration des performances durables des bâtiments sur l'ensemble de leur cycle de vie, en s'appuyant sur le BIM comme support d'intégration, de structuration et d'exploitation des données relatives aux matériaux, aux procédés, aux usages et aux performances.

•      Développer des méthodes permettant d'enrichir les maquettes BIM avec des données matériaux fiables : propriétés mécaniques, thermiques, hydriques, environnementales, durabilité, vieillissement, réparabilité, potentiel de réemploi et recyclabilité ;

•      Intégrer l'éco-conception dans les processus BIM à travers l'aide au choix des matériaux, l'analyse de solutions constructives bas carbone, l'évaluation multicritère et le couplage avec l'analyse du cycle de vie et l'analyse des coûts sur le cycle de vie ;

•      Construire des approches numériques pour optimiser le recyclage, le réemploi et la valorisation matière en fin de vie des bâtiments, notamment via des inventaires BIM, des passeports matériaux, la traçabilité des ressources et des scénarios de déconstruction sélective ;

•      Prendre en compte la performance réelle des bâtiments pendant leur exploitation en reliant les données BIM aux données de monitoring, de capteurs, de GTB/GTC, de maintenance, d'usage et de consommation ;

•      Traiter les questions d'interopérabilité, de qualité et de gouvernance des données : formats IFC, openBIM, bases de données matériaux, ontologies, modèles de données, tableaux de bord d'indicateurs et aide à la décision ;

•      Valoriser les moyens expérimentaux du CERI MP pour produire des données matériaux utiles aux modèles numériques, aux maquettes BIM et aux outils d'aide au choix des solutions constructives durables ;

•      Publier les résultats dans des revues et conférences reconnues et contribuer à l'encadrement de doctorants, post-doctorants, ingénieurs, stagiaires de master et projets de fin d'études recherche.

Recherche partenariale, innovation et valorisation :

Un volet important du poste portera sur le développement de collaborations avec les acteurs industriels et territoriaux de la construction durable. La personne recrutée devra contribuer à faire émerger des projets de recherche appliquée, des démonstrateurs et des cas d'usage en lien avec les besoins du secteur.

•      Développer des partenariats avec les entreprises du BTP, bureaux d'études, maîtres d'ouvrage, maîtres d'œuvre, exploitants de bâtiments, industriels des matériaux, plateformes de recyclage, acteurs de la déconstruction et éditeurs ou intégrateurs de solutions BIM ;

•      Monter et piloter des projets collaboratifs : thèses CIFRE, projets régionaux, ADEME, ANR, Horizon Europe, Interreg, chaires industrielles, prestations de recherche et démonstrateurs pédagogiques ou technologiques ;

•      Contribuer à la réponse aux appels à projets, à la rédaction de livrables scientifiques et techniques, à la valorisation des résultats et au transfert vers les entreprises et les collectivités ;

•      Participer à des réseaux académiques et professionnels dans les domaines du BIM, de la construction durable, de l'économie circulaire, des matériaux bas carbone et de la performance du bâtiment.

Contribution à la vie de l'école :

•      Participer aux jurys, soutenances, conseils pédagogiques, actions de promotion, forums, journées portes ouvertes et événements de valorisation scientifique ;

•      Contribuer à la dynamique collective du CERI MP, aux actions transversales avec les autres centres de recherche et aux démarches qualité de l'École ;

•      Accompagner les étudiants dans leur professionnalisation, leur ouverture aux enjeux environnementaux et leur capacité à travailler dans des environnements collaboratifs et numériques.


PROFIL : (Prérequis/ Diplôme)

Le poste s'adresse à une personne titulaire d'un doctorat en génie civil, bâtiment durable, BIM/construction numérique, sciences et ingénierie des matériaux, performance énergétique et environnementale des bâtiments, sciences des données appliquées à la construction, ou dans un domaine proche. Une Habilitation à Diriger des Recherches, une expérience postdoctorale, une expérience d'enseignement en école d'ingénieurs ou une expérience industrielle dans le secteur de la construction constitueront des atouts.

Le profil recherché devra combiner une culture scientifique solide, une capacité à enseigner à des élèves ingénieurs et une volonté de construire un programme de recherche partenarial à l'interface entre BIM, matériaux durables, économie circulaire et performance du bâtiment.

Savoir-être :

•      Goût pour l'enseignement et l'accompagnement des élèves ;

•      Capacité à travailler en équipe pluridisciplinaire ;

•      Autonomie, rigueur scientifique et sens de l'organisation ;

•      Capacité d'écoute et de dialogue avec les partenaires industriels ;

•      Esprit d'initiative, créativité et orientation projet ;

•      Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de transition écologique.

Savoir-faire :

•      Concevoir et animer des cours, TD, TP et projets BIM ;

•      Encadrer stages, PFE, alternants, doctorants et projets de recherche ;

•      Monter et piloter des projets collaboratifs avec des entreprises ;

•      Structurer des données BIM et les relier à des indicateurs de performance ;

•      Valoriser des résultats par publications, rapports, démonstrateurs et communications ;

•      Travailler en français et en anglais.

Connaissances :

•      BIM, openBIM, IFC, maquette numérique et coordination BIM ;

•      Matériaux de construction durables, bas carbone, bio/géosourcés, recyclés ;

•      Éco-conception, analyse du cycle de vie, indicateurs carbone et coûts sur cycle de vie ;

•      Réemploi, recyclage, valorisation matière et déconstruction sélective ;

•      Performance énergétique, environnementale et hygrothermique des bâtiments.

La maîtrise d'outils ou environnements tels que Revit, Archicad, Tekla, Navisworks, Solibri, Dynamo, Grasshopper, Rhino, eveBIM, logiciels ACV, logiciels de simulation énergétique, bases IFC, Python ou bases de données sera appréciée. Le recrutement privilégiera toutefois la capacité à construire une vision scientifique et pédagogique du BIM plutôt qu'une expertise limitée à un outil logiciel.

La résidence administrative est fixée à Douai. Des déplacements sont à prévoir sur les autres sites de l'école et auprès des partenaires.

title: Data Center Technician (all genders)
description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Data Center Technician (all genders) to join our new data center in Lauterbourg as soon as possible.
 

Our customers all around the world rely on Contabo's infrastructure. With our support they run their businesses and store their data. What they never see is what makes it all possible: the humming servers, the precisely cooled halls and our power systems that never sleep.
That's your world.
As a Data Center Technician at our Lauterbourg site, you are the person who makes sure the lights stay on. You know your facility better than anyone: every cable tray, every cooling unit, every alarm.
You monitor and maintain our complete infrastructure: electrical systems from MV/LV distribution to grounding, UPS systems kept tested and ready and HVAC/cooling systems that keep everything running at optimal temperature and efficiency.
You work hands-on with our Building Management System, catch issues before they become incidents and when something does go wrong, you're the one who keeps calm, diagnoses fast and gets things back on track.
 
Beyond day-to-day operations, you'll plan and execute preventive maintenance, coordinate with external subcontractors and continuously push to make our processes sharper and more reliable. Over time, you'll take the lead on maintenance activities, develop predictive approaches and eventually help shape the infrastructure strategy itself. Also it’s important that you have fun to pass your knowledge on to our technicians in the team.

To be honest: there's never been a more exciting time to join us. We're not just maintaining a data center; we're still in the process building one hall. A brand-new HPC facility is taking shape on site and you'll be part of that from The Ground up. Your fingerprints will be on the infrastructure that powers Contabo's next chapter.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in facilities, HVAC or electrical maintenance
  • Knowledge of HVAC and cooling systems -  this is your core strength
  • Familiarity with electrical systems (MV/LV), UPS and BMS platforms
  • Valid electrical safety or HVAC certification (or equivalent)
  • Safety-first mindset: you follow protocols and set the standard for others
  • Cool under pressure, reliable and comfortable with on-call rotations
  • Strong communicator who works well in a team and with external contractors
  • Good English skills; German and/or French are a plus
  • Data center or industrial facility background is also a plus
  • Technical diploma or vocational training in electrical engineering, HVAC or facility management is a helpful add on
 
We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer: 

  • great freedom for your creative ideas.

  • Convenient transport connections, new modern and well-equipped office and workshop space with the option to contribute creatively to the design.
  • support with your relocation
  • a comprehensive induction with your colleagues by your side.
  • 30-day vacation by default.

  • attractive conditions on many products and services through our corporate benefits program.
  • unforgettable moments at our company events and team events.

description:
Join our Data & Analytics team at Crypto Finance, headquartered in the Prime Tower in Zurich. Your primary mandate is pushing the company’s AI strategy forward: identifying use cases across departments, engineering production-grade AI and automation solutions, and helping to build the firm's AI governance practice. This is a hybrid role for someone who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder workshop and an IDE. The work potentially spans AI agents and copilots, deterministic automation, RAG systems, and the data infrastructure they rely on. You will be expected to push back on bad use cases as much as you ship good ones. 

What you will do: 

AI & Automation Engineering 

  • Work with stakeholders across Compliance, Trading, Operations, Legal, Sales, and Finance to identify, scope, and prioritize use cases that genuinely move the needle. 
  • Engineer production data solutions: Deterministic automations, AI agents, RAG systems over internal documents, structured extraction pipelines. 
  • Build the firm's "innovation lab" environment where new use cases can be prototyped and evaluated. 
  • Maintain prompt and skill libraries as reusable, version-controlled assets, not as one-off scripts. 

AI Governance and Inventory 

  • Maintain the firm-wide inventory of AI systems and use cases, including those built outside D&A. 
  • Run the operational side of the company’s AI approval process: documentation, risk classification, model cards, evaluation artifacts. Policy is set at the executive level; you make sure the operational practice meets it. 
  • Conduct technical review of new AI initiatives proposed elsewhere in the company; advise on scope, risk, and design choices. 

Data Engineering and Platform 

  • Contribute to ELT pipelines on the Dagster + SQLMesh + dlt stack, primarily where AI & automation use cases require new data sources or transformations. 
  • Build the data substrate that AI workloads consume; feature views, document indexes, and structured event tables.  
  • Maintain infrastructure as code in Git with proper review and deployment standards. 

 

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of relevant experience. We are flexible on title, could be AI engineer, analytics engineer with AI focus, or data engineer who is pivoted to AI. What matters is shipped work. 
  • Demonstrable production experience with LLM applications: at minimum structured extraction with LLMs, and agentic patterns (tool use, multi-step workflows). You can describe what failed and what you learned. 
  • Strong Python; comfortable building production ready code, not just notebooks. 
  • Working knowledge of evaluation discipline for LLM applications (eval sets, regression tests, observability), conceptual understanding of retrieval, and how to handle hallucination. 
  • Familiarity with at least one orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect) and one transformation framework (SQLMesh, dbt). 
  • Solid SQL (window functions, joins, query design).

  • Genuine curiosity about regulated environments and the discipline they require. 
  • Professional proficiency in English (German is a plus). 
  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss permit or EU/EFTA citizenship). 

Equally important is how you think: 

  • You reach for the simplest thing that works. Boring SQL before vector search. Rules before agents. You can explain why. 
  • You are comfortable saying "this is not an AI problem" when the right answer is a dashboard, a process fix, or a deterministic script. 
  • You can run a stakeholder workshop and write production code in the same week. 
  • You take documentation, evaluation, and audit trails seriously, not as overhead. 

Nice to have: 

  • Prior exposure to regulated financial services, crypto, or comparable model-risk environments. 

What we are not looking for: 

  • "Prompt engineers" with no production experience. 
  • Pure data engineers using this posting to pivot into AI without prior LLM work. 
  • Strategists or generalist "AI enthusiasts." This is a builder role. 

Benefits

  • Shape the future of finance while working at the cutting edge of B2B digital asset solutions
  • Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with flat hierarchies

  • Gain deep industry insights and make a tangible impact
  • Join regular company-wide meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and team events
  • Enjoy a modern and central workplace in Zurich with top-tier infrastructure

Our culture

At the heart of our company, we prioritize:

  • Innovation and Continuous Learning
  • Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing

  • Values such as Excellence, Delivery, Ownership, Passion, and Unity

Bei uns entwickelst du an einer Plattform, die rechtliche Prozesse digital abbildet und automatisiert. Dazu gehören Schnittstellen und Plugins, über die unsere Inhalte in die Shopsysteme unserer Mitglieder gelangen, sowie Integrationen mit Partnersystemen. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die technische Leitung von Projekten, die wir in kleinen Projektteams umsetzen: Du konzipierst Lösungen, verantwortest die Umsetzung, leitest andere Entwickler im Projekt an und hältst alle Beteiligten über den Stand auf dem Laufenden. Kleinere Projekte setzt du eigenständig komplett um, bei größeren arbeitest du im Team mit Laravel und Livewire im Stack.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Technische Konzeption: Analyse von Anforderungen, Entwurf der Lösungsarchitektur, Festlegung von Datenmodellen und Schnittstellen sowie Einschätzung von Aufwänden für Features und Projekte.

  • Reporting: Regelmäßige, verständliche Berichte zu Stand, Risiken und nächsten Schritten an Team Lead, Product Owner und Stakeholder.

  • Fullstack-Entwicklung: Umsetzung mit Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS. Kleinere Projekte eigenständig von Anfang bis Ende, größere im Projektteam.

  • Partneranbindungen & Integrationen: Lösungsevaluierung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Schnittstellen zu Partner- und Drittsystemen.

  • Architektur & Technologie-Evaluation: Mitgestaltung von Architektur, Entwicklungsstandards und Tooling; Evaluation neuer Technologien, Frameworks und KI-Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Hinblick auf ihren konkreten Nutzen für Produkt und Team.


Dein Profil

Technisch

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PHP & Laravel: Entwicklung von Webanwendungen über den gesamten Stack, im Frontend idealerweise mit Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS.

  • Konzeption & technische Leitung: Erfahrung darin, technische Konzepte zu erarbeiten und deren Umsetzung zu verantworten, allein oder als technische Leitung eines Projektteams.

  • Code Reviews über den gesamten Stack: Praxis im Review von Backend- und Frontend-Code und die Fähigkeit, Feedback so zu geben, dass andere daran wachsen.

  • Testerfahrung: Sicherer Umgang mit PHPUnit oder Pest und Erfahrung mit Teststrategien in größeren Codebasen. Tests sind für dich Teil der Umsetzung, nicht Nacharbeit.

  • Datenbanken & APIs: Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und API-Design.

  • Agile Teamarbeit: Erfahrung in agilen Teams, idealerweise mit Scrum, inklusive enger Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichem Austausch.


Nice to Have, aber kein Muss

  • DevOps-Erfahrung: Cloud-Systeme, PaaS-Plattformen, Container, CI/CD oder Linux-Serveradministration (z.B. DigitalOcean und Laravel Cloud)

  • Erfahrung mit Shopsystemen und der Entwicklung von Plugins oder Apps dafür (z.B. Shopify oder JTL)

  • Gespür für UX und Erfahrung in der Gestaltung benutzerfreundlicher Oberflächen

  • Erfahrung mit Event-basierten Architekturen, Queues oder asynchronen Verarbeitungsprozessen

  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von LLM-APIs in Produktfeatures (Prompting, Evaluierung, Guardrails)


Persönlich

  • Ownership: Du fühlst dich für das Ergebnis eines Projekts verantwortlich. Von der ersten Skizze bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus und nicht nur für deine eigenen Tickets.

  • Systemisches Denken: Du siehst die Auswirkungen von Änderungen über Komponenten- und Teamgrenzen hinweg.

  • Strukturierte Kommunikation: Du bereitest den Stand eines Projekts für technische und nicht-technische Beteiligte verständlich auf, auch dann, wenn etwas nicht nach Plan läuft.

  • Pragmatismus: Du findest die Balance zwischen sauberer Lösung und pragmatischem Fortschritt.

  • Wissenstransfer: Du hast Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und andere im Team besser zu machen, bspw. in Reviews, Pairings und Dokumentation.

  • KI als Werkzeug: Du nutzt KI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag selbstverständlich und beurteilst nüchtern, wo sie im Produkt echten Nutzen bringen und wo nicht.


Warum wir?

Code. Chill. Repeat.

Sauberer Code, smarte Entscheidungen und ein Team, das zusammenarbeitet. Professionalität heißt hier: Du kannst dich auf das konzentrieren, was du am besten kannst – entwickeln.
