title: Full Stack Product Engineer (100% Remote - Germany | UK | Ireland)
description:
Build analytics people can trust. Help define what analytics looks like in an AI-first world.

Most analytics platforms ask organisations to trade control for insight.

For almost 20 years, Matomo has shown there is another way: powerful, transparent and trustworthy analytics that respects privacy, gives organisations ownership of their data, and helps people understand what's happening, make better decisions, and improve their work.

More than one million websites use Matomo. That means you'll work on software that is widely used, technically demanding, and close enough to customers that your work has a visible impact. It's a rare opportunity for engineers: solving meaningful, complex product problems while seeing the difference your work makes for customers.

We are independent, profitable, and open source. We are not trying to become a smaller copy of Big Tech analytics platforms. We are building a different kind of analytics company: one where privacy, transparency, customer control, and product quality are part of the core product, not marketing claims.

This role focuses on Matomo Core, the foundation of our product and the platform our open-source users, cloud customers, and wider plugin ecosystem depend on.

If you want unusually high ownership, visible impact, hard product & platform problems, and the opportunity to strengthen a widely used open-source platform, Matomo is worth a serious look.


Why this role matters

Matomo Core is the foundation of our open-source product, cloud platform, plugins, integrations and customer-facing features. 

It has evolved over many years and operates across a wide range of environments, use cases and data volumes. Every improvement to Core benefits customers, open-source users, plugin developers and engineering teams across the Matomo ecosystem. 

We are bringing responsibility for Core into a newly formed European team. You'll help shape how this team works, where it focuses and how it creates the greatest impact across Matomo. 

As a Product Engineer, you’ll help decide where Core can create the greatest impact. That could mean solving a difficult customer problem, strengthening an existing capability, creating a new platform capability, or simplifying the Core platform to make it easier to evolve. 

You’ll work on a mature and technically complex product. The challenge is not simply to preserve what exists. It is to understand why it exists, recognise where it is holding customers or engineers back, and evolve it without disrupting the open-source users, customers, integrations and plugins that already depend on it. 


What you’ll own

You'll own problems, not just code. 

This is not a traditional feature-ticket engineering role. You'll understand customer problems, shape solutions, build across the stack, ship incrementally and continuously improve what you release. AI should be part of your everyday workflow. 

You'll own work from problem to outcome: 

  • Understand the problem before committing to a solution.  

  • Help shape priorities, not just implement them.  

  • Build across the stack wherever the problem takes you.  

  • Ship incrementally and learn from real usage.  

  • Measure outcomes and iterate.  

  • Use AI throughout your workflow. 

    • For senior: You'll help shape what we build, not only how we build it. You'll identify opportunities others haven't seen, influence technical and product direction, and help establish how the Core team operates as it grows. 

    For intermediate: You'll contribute to deciding what we build, working closely with product, engineering and customers rather than simply implementing predefined requirements. You'll own meaningful problems end-to-end while building confidence in navigating ambiguity and product trade-offs. 

    What the work looks like 

    You'll work across the Core platform wherever you can create the greatest impact. 

    Examples include: 

    • Diagnosing and solving complex problems across a large, mature codebase.  

    • Strengthening the security, performance, scalability, reliability and resilience of Matomo.  

    • Protecting the integrity, accuracy and trustworthiness of the data customers rely on.  

    • Strengthen capabilities that support increasingly demanding enterprise use cases.  

    • Building and evolving APIs and platform capabilities used by Matomo plugins and integrations.  

    • Evolving how Matomo handles consent, privacy and responsible data collection. 

    • Advancing server-side tracking, data anonymisation and data-health monitoring. 

    • Enhancing analytics capabilities such as goals, ecommerce reporting and dashboards.

    • Simplifying complex analytics workflows and making powerful functionality easier to use.  

    • Evolving Matomo's design system to create a more consistent and usable product experience. 


How we work

We’re a small team competing with companies many times our size.

That means we optimise for impact.

We value:

  • Customer problems over technical elegance.

  • Shipping over endless planning.

  • Simple solutions over unnecessary complexity.

  • Ownership over handoffs.

  • Iteration over perfection.

  • Clear writing over excessive meetings.

  • Pragmatic engineering over abstract architecture.

  • AI where it helps us move faster.

  • Measuring outcomes over assuming we were right.

    • We care about high standards, but we do not confuse high standards with slow processes. We would rather ship a small useful improvement, learn from it, and improve it than spend months perfecting something before customers see it.

    At the same time, changes to Matomo Core can affect a large number of customers, integrations and plugins. You should be able to move pragmatically while recognising when additional investigation, testing or migration planning is necessary.


What we’re looking for

For senior: You're already operating with a high degree of autonomy. You naturally identify valuable opportunities, make pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations, and multiply the team's impact through the systems you build, the decisions you influence and the way you approach problems. 

For intermediate: You're already comfortable delivering software independently and are looking to take greater ownership of customer problems, product decisions and technical direction. 

You enjoy building products

You get motivated by solving customer problems and delivering value, not by technical novelty alone.

You care whether people actually use and benefit from what you build. Seeing a feature make a real difference is more rewarding to you than building something technically clever that nobody uses.

You naturally ask:

  • What problem are we solving?

  • Who has this problem?

  • Is this the simplest useful solution?

  • How will we know this made things better?

  • What should we do if the data shows we were wrong?

    • You are comfortable with complex, mature systems

    You do not need every problem to start with a clean architecture or an empty repository.

    You are comfortable tracing behaviour across an unfamiliar codebase, understanding historical constraints, debugging difficult interactions, and making incremental improvements without unnecessary rewrites.

    You can balance immediate customer needs with longer-term platform health. You know when to fix the immediate issue, when to address the underlying cause, and when a broader architectural change is justified.

    You are comfortable across the stack

    You are happy working wherever the problem takes you: frontend, backend, databases, APIs, product flows, documentation, or customer feedback.

    Our stack includes PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Vue.js, and TypeScript. Exact stack experience is useful, but not required. We care more about your ability to learn, reason, ship, and solve meaningful problems.

    You use AI as part of how you work

    We make heavy use of AI-assisted development throughout our engineering workflow.

    You should already be using AI tools regularly or be strongly motivated to do so. We expect Product Engineers to use AI to increase output and quality.

    AI does not replace your judgment. You remain responsible for product decisions, technical correctness, security, privacy, maintainability, and customer impact.


You’ll probably thrive here if

  • You prefer owning outcomes over receiving detailed tickets.

  • You enjoy solving difficult problems in existing systems as well as building new functionality.

  • You can quickly diagnose complex or intermittent bugs.

  • You can move from customer feedback or operational evidence to investigation, product decision and implementation.

  • You care about reliability, performance and data accuracy, not only visible feature work.

  • You can improve a mature codebase without assuming it needs to be rewritten.

  • You use AI tools heavily and are actively improving how you work with them.

  • You are pragmatic: you can make a focused improvement now while recognising when a deeper change is needed.

  • You can explain technical and product trade-offs clearly.

  • You enjoy working across product, engineering, UX, data and customer feedback.

  • You like small teams where your decisions and output visibly matter.

    • below for intermediate only:

    • You're excited to take on increasingly ambiguous problems.  

      • You want to grow beyond implementation into shaping products and technical decisions. 


You may not enjoy this role if

The team is newly formed and set to grow, with a mix of internal and external engineers. Together with your Product Manager, you shape both the experiences we ship and the team that builds them, bringing joy to millions of children worldwide. Ready to help us create the future of audio play?


Your tasks and responsibilities will include:

  • Team Leadership: You nurture the professional growth of your engineers and build a culture where inclusive mentorship, continuous learning, and high collaboration are the norm — across disciplines, and across internal and external team members alike.

  • Technical Credibility & Hands-on Depth: You stay close enough to the code to run high-impact reviews, challenge architectural decisions, and step in on critical problems — so our quality standards remain uncompromised, including for work delivered by external partners.

Your Team's Responsibilities

  • Designing, building, and maintaining the Above-the-Box experience — our value stream covering everything our users experience beyond the box itself:

    • Content-, Creative- and Clever Tonies

    • Tonieplay

  • Delivering these experiences across the full stack, from on-device software through app and cloud services

  • Specifying the abstract interfaces (APIs) delivered by our lower-level platform teams, so the team can own its experiences end to end across hardware generations

  • Safeguarding quality through end-to-end ownership and test automation owned inside the team

  • Partnering closely with Product Management to translate the experience roadmap into sustainable delivery

  • Acting as the point of contact for Above-the-Box topics across the wider engineering organisation


What we are looking for:

  • Leadership & Team Empowerment: You have experience leading engineering teams—including specialists outside your own discipline—and excel at turning complex challenges into a clear vision. You seamlessly integrate external engineers and partners to build one unified team grounded in shared standards, collective ownership, and zero second-class contributors.

  • Technical Acumen & Hands-on Depth: You bring a long-standing background as a software engineer with genuine full-stack breadth — you have depth in embedded, backend, or mobile development, and enough working knowledge of the others to reason about, review, and challenge decisions across the whole stack. While your focus is on leadership and design, you can still dive into the codebase to unblock critical bottlenecks.

  • Architectural Vision: You advocate for modular, flexibly extendable, loosely coupled architectures with strong cohesion — so a feature can be built once and shipped across several hardware generations without being rewritten each time.

  • Strategic Product Alignment: You act as the bridge between engineering and product strategy. You translate business goals into technical reality and collaborate seamlessly across departments to keep our roadmap both ambitious and achievable.

  • The Toolbox: Solid experience with software platforms and their architecture. Linux is your home ground, and Git, GitLab, and CI/CD are part of your daily workflow. Experience working with ODMs or hardware suppliers is a strong plus.

  • Clean Design & Simplicity: You champion lean structures and have a knack for solving complex problems with simple, elegant solutions — in code and in organisational processes alike.

  • Work Style: Your approach is defined by agility, empathy, and creativity, especially when exploring new solutions or navigating change.

  • Communication & Collaboration: You communicate confidently in professional English (German is a plus) and enjoy being with your team in the office regularly.

Why tonies?

Good to know:

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Sabine Schykowski
Talent Acquisition Manager

title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Description

We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order.


Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.


Why join us?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.
  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.
  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.
  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.
Still unsure about why joining us?
  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.
  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.
  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.
  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.
Let’s make the invisible visible!


What will you do

  • Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements.
  • Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months.
  • Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team.
  • Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements.
  • For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans.
  • Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines.
  • Support go-to-market: give input on positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and documentation scope together with the applications, operations, and product development teams.


What is expected of you

  • Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment.
  • A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from.
  • The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them.
  • Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with the people designing the product, across mechanics, optics, electronics/RF, and software.
  • Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning.
  • We hire for demonstrated skill rather than a specific degree; a technical or scientific background is typical. The working language is English.
Additional experience we value:
  • Semiconductor industry knowledge (fabs, IDMs, OSATs, inspection, metrology, or failure analysis).
  • Familiarity with SEMI standards and fab tool integration (for example, S2/S8, E10, SECS/GEM).
  • Experience selecting or setting up a requirements management tool (for example, Jama, Polarion, or CodeBeamer).
  • A working understanding of quantum sensing, optics, or precision instrumentation.


Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.
  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.
  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.
  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.
  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.
  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.
  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

title: Senior Software Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
About us

The appliedAI Initiative elevates Europe’s industry to become shapers in the age of AI, creating a future that we desire to live in. Through our ecosystem of strong partners, comprehensive programs, services and solutions we advance companies holistically on their AI journey. With our uniquely diverse, interdisciplinary, and driven team, we build on deep technical expertise while specializing on applicability of the solutions. We share a mindset of collaboration and openness with our ecosystem of leading companies and tech players. Our common goal is to strengthen the European landscape, jointly creating unique knowledge for applying trustworthy AI. We believe that AI Agents will be the dominant topic for AI in the near future and that appliedAI with its partner ecosystem will impact how this technology is being used in industry and beyond in Europe.


Your mission

Most of what makes an AI solution survive contact with a large enterprise is not the AI. It is the engineering discipline around it, and that discipline is what you bring. You do not need to arrive as an AI expert - you arrive as someone who knows how professional software gets built, shipped, and kept alive, and you grow into the agentic side alongside a team that is already deep in it. In our Engineering team you set the bar for what production-ready means here.
Your tasks will include:

  • Designing the technical approach for a system slice, from build and test through deployment and operation, including the documentation and artefacts a third party needs to run it without us
  • Shaping how we develop: issue workflows, branching and review standards, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, security checks, and release management
  • Building the classical software around the AI core - services and APIs, data pipelines, infrastructure as code, mostly in Python on Azure 
  • Making solutions operable in enterprise IT landscapes: observability, failure behaviour, security posture, and cost transparency
  • Providing specialist guidance that shapes technical decisions across workstreams, and raising the engineering bar through design and code reviews
  • Making technical trade-offs legible to senior client stakeholders - what a given architecture or operating model costs and enables

description:
About us

At CYCLE, we're redefining urban mobility for the people who keep cities moving: couriers, riders, and delivery pros. Our e-bike subscription service combines durable vehicles, fast repairs, and real support, everything riders need to stay on the road.
From Berlin to London, Vienna to Amsterdam, we operate in 200+ cities across Europe, providing thousands of riders with bikes built for work, not for show.
Our mission is simple: make last-mile delivery more reliable, affordable, and sustainable, one ride at a time. With every bike we deploy, we're helping build the backbone of smarter, greener cities.
Ride with us into the future - sustainable, efficient, and full speed ahead!


Your Mission

As Head of Supply Chain, you own every part of how physical goods reach our fleet and our riders, from the purchase order to the shelf to the courier's bike. You report to our Director of Operations and work directly with Hardware, Finance, Software and our country teams. In particular you will:

  • Own supply chain end to end: Purchasing, warehousing, stock keeping and outbound logistics across our European network, as one function with one owner. You ultimately ensure we have the right number of bikes, batteries and parts at the right time, the right place and the best price.
  • Oversee our assembly & refurbishment activities: Manage our assembly and refurbishment partners, own the bills of material for everything we build from purchased components as well as internal refurbishment within our locations.
  • Own the systems, not just the process: Take full responsibility for our ERP and warehouse management setup for all supply chain topics, from data model and master data through to daily execution – you will be the business owner to our software team and guide implementation.
  • Professionalize the structure: Design and implement the processes, controls and physical setup our growing operation needs, and then get your hands dirty making them real and ensuring your organization internalizes them.
  • Own the numbers behind the goods: You will guide the rest of the company on such topics as transfer prices, landed cost allocation and other supply-chain related financials, ensuring each business line's P&L is accurately reflecting parts consumption and asset usage – together with our Finance team.
  • Drive the agenda across teams: Set priorities, align Hardware, Finance and Tech behind them, and hold the line when it matters. 
  • Partner with the larger organization and understand your impact on them: All you do, you do with the end goal in mind to become the best friend of our Local and Country Operations and Sales teams, who all depend on your fulfillment excellence to grow and maintain their businesses.
  • Lead and grow your team: Build a supply chain organization that scales with us across markets.


Your skills and qualifications

We are looking for someone who has built structure inside a well-run company and is ready to build it again from scratch, with their sleeves rolled up. Ideally you bring:

  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience, of which at least 5 in a managerial supply chain or operations role.
  • Experience leading a team of at least 3 direct reports in a supply chain or operations-heavy function.
  • Structure from an established company: You have worked inside proper processes and systems and know what good looks like.
  • 0 to 1 experience: You have also built something from nothing in a smaller or fast-moving company or demonstrated you can excel in such a setting, and you are comfortable being scrappy when that is what the situation needs.
  • Commercial and financial fluency: Working capital optimization, inter-company transactions or product costing,  are all familiar territory for you.
  • Cross-functional communication: You can carry a topic across teams and drive it to a decision.
  • Ownership and a firm, professional attitude: You take the whole problem, not your part of it.
  • English at C1 level or above

Nice to have:
  • Hands-on experience with Odoo or a comparable ERP, ideally including experience in shaping or designing a system for supply chain topics rather than execution alone.
  • Background in bike, scooter, mobility or another hardware-heavy industry where physical goods move between internal as well as external locations.
  • German or Dutch


What you can expect from us


  • Exciting industry: You will work in the dynamic world of mobility, which is a constantly evolving sector.
  • Real impact: Your work improves the lives of many bike couriers.
  • Take on immediate responsibility: Start making a difference right away and implement your own ideas. Boredom? Not a chance!

  • International team & Strong network: Work alongside motivated colleagues from all over the world. Teamwork is very important to us.
  • Fair conditions: We offer a stable employment with attractive salary, €50 HRmony voucher, a company e-bike, modern equipment and 28 days' holiday a year.


Diversity

At CYCLE, we believe diversity makes us stronger. No matter who you are, where you're from, or what makes you unique, you're welcome here.

description:
Ihre Aufgaben

Bei NYALA begleitest Du die Weiterentwicklung unseres Angebots von juristischer Seite. Du lernst, regulatorische Anforderungen umzusetzen sowie zu diesen mit den Aufsichtsbehörden zu kommunizieren. Du hast damit nicht nur die Möglichkeit, die geltenden Regelungen auf konkrete Sachverhalte im Unternehmen anzuwenden (und das anders als in der Kanzlei umfassend und gestaltend, nicht nur im Rahmen eines beschränkten Beratungsauftrags), sondern auch zukünftige Entwicklungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 
Im operativen Tagesgeschäft arbeitest du direkt dem Geldwäsche-, Compliance- und Risikobeauftragten zu, bereitest Sachverhalte entscheidungsreif auf und hältst Fristen, Maßnahmen und Wiedervorlagen nach.
Im Schwerpunkt des Berichtswesens erstellst du Vorlagen für die Berichte an Funktionsträger im Unternehmen, pflegst Kennzahlen und Auswertungen, hältst Richtlinien, Handbücher und Arbeitsanweisungen aktuell und unterstützt bei Jahresabschluss- und Sonderprüfungen.


Ihr Profil

Du brennst für Technologie und speziell DLT, glaubst an die revolutionäre Chance der Blockchain im Finanzsystem und hast Interesse an kapitalmarktrechtlichen Fragestellungen. Vollständige Vorkenntnisse in eWpG, GwG und KWG erwarten wir nicht; ein großer Teil dieses Rechtsrahmens ist selbst erst wenige Jahre alt und entwickelt sich beständig weiter. Wir erwarten Sorgfalt im Detail, Verbindlichkeit bei Fristen, die Fähigkeit, komplizierte Sachverhalte knapp und nachvollziehbar zu verschriftlichen, und Diskretion im Umgang mit Kunden- und Unternehmensdaten. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch ist für Aufsichtskorrespondenz und im Meldewesen erforderlich, Englisch für Korrespondenz mit internationalen Kunden und für die Interpretation von Rechtstexten von Vorteil.

Compliance ist bei uns nicht nur nachgelagerte Kontrollinstanz, sondern Voraussetzung des Geschäftsmodells: ohne belastbare Registerführung und rechtssichere Verfahrensabläufe gibt es kein Kryptowertpapier. Werde Teil eines motivierten, technikbegeisterten und internationalen Teams mit starker Unternehmenskultur direkt am Ku'damm in Berlin. Wir bieten dir Einarbeitung unmittelbar durch die Beauftragten, direkten Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – und die Perspektive, in Themen eigenverantwortlich hineinzuwachsen. Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. Jeder unserer Kunden erhält ein dediziertes Kubernetes-Cluster auf Basis des SUSE-Stacks (Harvester, RKE2), ausgerollt und verwaltet über Fleet, mit eigenem Tenant-Management.

Du bist nicht Betreiber eines fremden Systems, sondern gestaltest die Plattform, auf der unsere Software als SaaS läuft — mit echter Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Informationssicherheit und Nachweisbarkeit sind auf allerhöchsten Level. Hierfür sind unsere Managed Services nach BSI C5 testiert.

Das erwartet dich

Plattform entwickeln und gestalten

  • Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der selbst gehosteten Cloud-Plattform (Multi-Cluster, ohne Hyperscaler-Abhängigkeit, volle Kontrolle)
  • Architektur und Design hochverfügbarer Kubernetes-Cluster im SUSE-Stack, inklusive Networking, Storage, Load Balancing und Authentifizierung
  • Design und Weiterentwicklung des Tenant-Konzepts: isolierte Kundenumgebungen, Verantwortung für Architektur und Lifecycle
  • Abstimmung mit der Entwicklung zu performance- und verfügbarkeitsrelevanten Anforderungen an das Cluster- und Tenant-Konzept
  • Weiterentwicklung des Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepts: Ein verteilter In-Memory Ansatz über mehrere Knoten (Schwarmtechnik), der die Echtzeitfähigkeit der Anwendungen im Normalbetrieb sicherstellt
Automatisieren und standardisieren
  • GitOps-Workflows über ArgoCD und Fleet — von der Erstauslieferung bis zum Day-2-Betrieb vollständig automatisiert
  • Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Tools; Policy as Code für Sicherheit und Governance
  • CI/CD-Integration und Standardisierung der Deployment-Prozesse
Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams und Kunden
  • Platform Engineering für interne Teams: Aufbau von Self-Service-Fähigkeiten, Definition von Standards, Begleitung des Onboardings
  • Aktive Unterstützung der Entwicklungsteams bei der Migration ihrer Workloads in die Cloud-Plattform
  • Verarbeitung von Erkenntnissen aus dem laufenden Betrieb (Monitoring-Daten, Incidents) zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Stabilität, Sicherheit und Performance


Das bringst du mit

Must-have

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Cloud- oder Platform-Engineering, in Container-Technologien oder Infrastrukturautomatisierung
  • Fundierte Kubernetes Kenntnisse, idealerweise aus dem Betrieb produktiver Multi-Cluster-Umgebungen
  • Erfahrung mit GitOps-Workflows (idealerweise ArgoCD oder Fleet) und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Ansible, Terraform)
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Termine an unseren weiteren Standorten
Nice-to-have
  • Erfahrung mit SUSE Stack oder vergleichbaren Kubernetes-Management-Plattformen
  • Kenntnisse in DevSecOps, Policy as Code oder Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepten
  • Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Stacks (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana)
Persönlich
  • Systemisches Denken statt Ticket-Fokus, mit Blick fürs Gesamtbild
  • Sicheres Auftreten und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe mit Entwicklungsteams wie mit Kunden
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Erfahrung darin, Themen über Team- und Kundengrenzen hinweg zu steuern


Was wir dir bieten

  • Übernimm Verantwortung und nutze deinen Gestaltungsspielraum, um eigene Ideen zu verwirklichen.

description:
Warum LPE Immobilien?

  • Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel.
  • Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren.
  • Für Design ist das ein seltener Ausgangspunkt: Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Für diese Berufe hat noch nie jemand ernsthaft gestaltet. Du wärst die erste Design-Person in unserem neuen Produktteam und baust Design-System und Designprozess mit auf.


Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben

  • Wir arbeiten als ein Team von Product Engineers, manche technischer, manche gestalterischer. Du wärst die gestalterischste Person, arbeitest aber im selben Repository und Rhythmus wie alle anderen. Was du gestaltest, ist meist wenige Wochen später live.
  • Du verantwortest den Designprozess von Anfang bis Ende: Du führst Interviews mit Verwaltern und Eigentümern, verdichtest die Erkenntnisse zu Konzepten und gestaltest daraus Interfaces für Kundenportal und Verwaltercockpit. Deine Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden sind direkt erreichbar, Feedback bekommst du auf kurzem und direktem Weg.
  • Deine Designs bleiben nicht in Figma: Mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung (React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui) bringst du sie selbst ins Frontend und setzt Teil-Features, teils auch ganze Features, gemeinsam mit dem Team um. Du musst kein Programmierer sein, aber du willst, dass deine Arbeit im Produkt landet, und legst dafür selbst Hand an.
  • Ein besonderes Feld ist Design für KI-Agenten: Du gestaltest Interaktionsmuster für Workflows, in denen Agenten Aufgaben übernehmen. Wo braucht der Nutzer Kontrolle, wo Transparenz? Muster, für die es noch kaum Vorbilder gibt.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktdesign, gern mit B2B-Software oder komplexen Workflows.
  • Ein Portfolio mit 2 bis 3 Case Studies, die deinen Weg von der Nutzerfrage bis zum ausgelieferten Interface zeigen: Deine Denkweise interessiert uns mehr als die Menge an Screens.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Figma, von Wireframes über klickbare Prototypen bis zur Komponentenbibliothek.
  • Erfahrung mit qualitativem Research: Interviews führen, Erkenntnisse verdichten, Annahmen mit Usability-Tests prüfen.
  • Gespür für Interaction Design und Informationsarchitektur in datenreichen Anwendungen.
  • Gute bis sehr gute Praxis mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, v0): Du bringst Teil-Features oder ganze Features selbst in den Code.
  • Solide Grundlagen in HTML und CSS, JavaScript ist ein Plus.
  • Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B2-Niveau.
Du erfüllst nicht alle Punkte? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Talent und Lernkurve zählen bei uns mehr als Jahreszahlen im Lebenslauf.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Eine seltene Ausgangslage. Wir bauen Software für ein Geschäftsmodell, das bereits funktioniert, und wissen, dass sie gebraucht wird. Du erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie sich eine ganze Branche neu erfindet, und gestaltest das aktiv mit.
  • Echter Impact. Alles, was du gestaltest, kommt bei unseren Verwaltern, Eigentümern und Kunden direkt zum Einsatz.
  • Eine Branche von innen kennenlernen. Die Immobilienwirtschaft ist einer der größten Märkte Deutschlands und steht erst am Anfang ihrer Digitalisierung. Du lernst sie dort kennen, wo die Entscheidungen fallen.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Produktverantwortlichen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und jemand, der sich Zeit für deine Fragen nimmt.
  • Mentoring und Weiterentwicklung. Wohin du dich entwickeln willst, Richtung UX Engineering oder Produktverantwortung, besprechen wir offen und regelmäßig. Mentoring ist bei uns in alle Richtungen möglich.
  • Ehrliches Feedback. Sofort und in beide Richtungen.
  • Die richtigen Werkzeuge. Premium-Hardware, cloudbasierte Tools, aktuelles KI-Tooling, papierlos. Wenn dir etwas fehlt, um besser zu arbeiten, bekommst du es.
  • Perspektive. Diese Stelle ist so gebaut, dass sie mit dir und mit lpeOS wächst.

title: Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem
description:
Your mission

As our Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem, you will define the product what and why for how ProGlove devices connect, integrate and create value within the enterprise Android ecosystem.

ProGlove is evolving from a wearable scanner company into a Worker Companion company, bringing together ergonomic wearable hardware, software, connectivity, workflow guidance, data and intelligence. With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure.

Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity.

You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners.

Your day-to-day 
  • Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals.
  • Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions.
  • Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions.
  • Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale.
  • Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner, balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity.
  • Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition.
  • Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes.
  • Enable Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly explain our Android proposition, supported capabilities, integrations and common deployment patterns.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities.


Your profile

At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions.

  • You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions.
  • You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value.
  • You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments.
  • You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed.
  • You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like.
  • You take end-to-end ownership, move topics forward without waiting for perfect instructions and remain effective when the product space or path ahead is not yet fully defined.
  • You collaborate generously and build trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture, customers and external partners. You can create alignment and drive decisions without relying on formal authority.
  • You communicate clearly and transparently, raise risks early and can make complex technical and commercial topics understandable to different audiences.
  • You are curious about customers, the business and emerging technologies, and continuously test assumptions rather than pursuing technology for its own sake.
  • You use pragmatic judgment to balance speed, simplicity, quality and long-term value.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required:

  • Enterprise Android, AOSP or adjacent Android ecosystems, including environments operating outside standard Google Mobile Services.
  • Enterprise mobility management, MDM/EMM, device provisioning, application deployment or connected fleet management.
  • Rugged or industrial devices, IoT or edge devices, connected hardware or other B2B technology ecosystems.
  • APIs, SDKs, developer or integrator experiences and enterprise integrations.
  • Platform or ecosystem strategy, technology partnerships, certification programs or developer and partner ecosystems.
  • Enterprise customers deploying technology at scale.
Direct Android Product Management experience is an advantage, but not essential if you bring strong Product Management expertise and relevant experience from an adjacent enterprise technology ecosystem.


Why us?

This is an opportunity to shape an important part of a category that is still being defined. 
Android gives ProGlove access to a much broader technology ecosystem, but the opportunity goes far beyond compatibility. You will help determine what role ProGlove should play in that ecosystem, which capabilities we should own, where we should partner, what customers and developers should be able to build around us, and where integration itself can become a source of differentiation and recurring business value. 
ProGlove already has the customer base, market credibility, technology and industrial expertise to build on. Our products are used in some of the world's most demanding operational environments. What we are now building is the next layer. 
Over time, success will mean more than making our own products easier to integrate. It will mean creating capabilities, interfaces and ecosystem relationships that customers, application providers and partners actively choose to build around - moving ProGlove from ecosystem participant toward ecosystem shaper. 
If you are excited by the idea of turning complex technology ecosystems into simple, valuable products - and helping shape how the next generation of frontline technology connects with the digital world - we would love to meet you. 
Join us in building the future of frontline work.


What success looks like

  • ProGlove has a clear, customer-backed strategy and prioritized roadmap for Android integration and ecosystem capabilities.
  • Recurring customer and integration needs are turned into scalable, repeatable solutions rather than one-off engineering projects.
  • Customers can adopt, integrate, deploy and manage ProGlove devices more easily within their existing enterprise environments.
  • Decisions about what ProGlove should own, enable or partner are made transparently and based on customer value, business impact and long-term scalability.
  • Product, Engineering, Sales and Solution Architecture are aligned on priorities, supported capabilities and key trade-offs.
  • Customer-facing teams can confidently communicate our Android proposition and common deployment patterns without relying on Product or Engineering in every opportunity.
  • Relevant integrations, partnerships and commercial opportunities are identified, validated and translated into tangible product or business outcomes.


Meet your team

You will join our Product team and report directly to the CPO. You will work especially closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion, as well as colleagues across Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture and Product Marketing.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You will bring together customer needs, technical realities and commercial opportunities, while also building relationships with external technology partners, platform providers and integrators. The team values open collaboration, clear communication and shared ownership of outcomes.

title: Staff/Senior Software Engineer - Hydris - Golang (d/f/m)
description:
New Challenge

About Us 
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a Germany-based DefenseTech company with offices in Berlin and Munich. We network market-available sensors, effectors, or situational awareness systems into a tactical IoT backbone that reliably provides armed forces and security agencies with cross-domain information superiority — automated, scalable, and cost-efficient.

Our solutions integrate seamlessly into existing defense and maritime infrastructures, delivering fast data fusion and AI-enhanced analytics for robust situational awareness in dynamic environments. We build platform-agnostic systems that enable real interoperability across domains.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll directly impact the technical direction of our orchestration products – Hydris – the coordination engine for sensors and mission systems, and the interoperability API that underpins it. 

You'll work at the layer where heterogeneous real-world systems like radars, AIS receivers, LoRa mesh radios, satellite feeds, and C2 platforms become a single coherent picture. The problems lie in distributed systems, protocols, and data modeling areas. They play out in environments that are bandwidth-constrained, intermittently connected, and operationally unforgiving. 

The role is deeply hands-on, but it expects you to shape what we build and how we build it, not just deliver what's specified.

What you'll do
Core engine development

  • Design and build the systems that power Hydris.
  • Go is your primary language. You should be comfortable reading Rust and TypeScript across the codebase, even if you're not writing in them day-to-day.
  • Own the architecture of a system that must run reliably on edge hardware, in disconnected mesh networks, and at scale — often all of that simultaneously.
Protocol and integration architecture
  • Evolve the schema that defines how every sensor, asset, and mission system talks to Hydris.
  • Make API design decisions that hold up across our client libraries without creating a maintenance burden.
  • Continue refining the integration framework that lets Hydris connect to new sensor types, data sources, and command systems.
  • Set the patterns for how built-in integrations (ADS-B, AIS, ASTERIX, Meshtastic, SpaceTrack, TAK, federation) are structured, tested, and maintained.
  • Make it straightforward for external developers and system vendors to build their own plugins/integrations to Hydris.
Distributed systems
  • Architect the peer-to-peer mesh and federation layer that keeps Hydris operational in disconnected, denied, intermittent, and limited-bandwidth environments.
  • Solve the hard coordination problems: conflict resolution across federated nodes, eventual consistency of entity state, and track correlation across unreliable links.
  • Ensure the system degrades gracefully rather than failing completely when connectivity is lost or constrained.
Technical leadership
  • Set technical standards for the codebase: how we test distributed behavior, how we handle protocol versioning, how we think about backward compatibility in an API-first product.
  • Review code with a focus on long-term maintainability and operational correctness, not just feature completion.
  • Make build-versus-integrate decisions and help the team clearly understand the trade-offs.

You should apply if you
  • Have built and shipped distributed systems that run in production, ideally in environments where reliability matters more than convenience.
  • Are comfortable working across the stack, from Protobuf schema design and systems-level Go, to the TypeScript that puts a map in front of a user.
  • Have well-formed views about API design and protocol evolution, informed by experience maintaining APIs that other people depend on.
  • Can operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy but are adept at collaboration with colleagues toward high-quality technical decisions, at scale.
  • Are interested in contributing to European military, maritime, and critical infrastructure defence systems.
  • Write clearly and communicate architectural decisions in a way that survives beyond the conversation where they were made. 
  • Working language is English. German is not required.
You'd be a great fit with
  • Experience with geospatial systems, sensor fusion, or track management.
  • Familiarity with defense or ISR data standards like CoT/TAK, ASTERIX, SAPIENT, MIL-STD-2525.
  • Background in networking, mesh architectures, or systems designed for contested or degraded communication environments.
  • Experience working on developer-facing open-source infrastructure where adoption depends on the quality of the API and documentation.

We Offer
  • Remote work anywhere in Germany, or hybrid/on-site in Berlin or Munich if you're already based there and prefer an office.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership, a flat structure, and real input into technical direction.
  • Annual €1500 Learning & development budget (available after probation).
  • Bike Leasing and Urban Sports Club membership.
  • 30 days of paid time off.
Note: We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role – candidates must already be eligible to work in Germany.

description:
You won't audit, you'll build what auditors use. We're looking for an experienced auditor who wants to switch sides: instead of working through audits, you'll shape the product that solves the real problems of the audit industry - with a real say in what we build next. Join an ambitious, international team and actively shape the future of dnl as well as the profession.

About dnl

dnl is a fast-growing AI startup building AI-first solutions for auditing. Our software automates disclosure checklists and other document-heavy audit work for audit firms and corporate clients, so professionals can spend their time on judgment instead of manual checking. Our mission: transform auditing through AI and help auditors work smarter than ever before.

The role

You bring many years of audit experience and use it to expand our platform conceptually. You co-decide which audit problems we solve next, design how our platform addresses them, and grow the value dnl contributes to every engagement. This role is for auditors, not career product managers: audit experience is required, product management experience is not.

You know first-hand where audits lose time, where risks are missed and which workarounds teams rely on. You don't need to code. You need to think in structured processes and want to build the tools you always wished you had. You work closely with our engineering and AI team, our customers and the management team.

Tasks

  • Identify the biggest pain points across the audit process - from planning to reporting – and turn them into new product areas beyond the current setup
  • Develop concepts for how our platform expands its coverage and grows its contribution to each audit engagement
  • Co-decide our product roadmap with the management team and engineering: validate problems with audit firms, prioritise what we build next and specify the audit logic behind it - including what "correct" looks like
  • Translate accounting and auditing standards (IFRS, HGB, ISA, IDW PS) into clear, software-executable logic, decision trees and workflows
  • Design review and control mechanisms that keep the auditor in charge - transparency, traceability and professional skepticism instead of blind reliance on AI
  • Make sure our results fit cleanly into audit working papers and firm methodologies
  • Work hands-on with engineering and AI to test outputs, evaluate quality and ship improvements fast
  • Be the voice of the auditor in the company and represent dnl with customers, at industry events and in regulatory discussions

Requirements

Must haves

  • 6+ years in financial statement audit, ideally at a Big 4 or leading mid-market firm, up to (senior) audit manager level
  • A solid understanding of engagement responsibility and liability risk - you know what it takes to sign off
  • Strong command of IFRS and/or HGB as well as ISA and IDW PS, and the ability to turn standards into reproducible processes
  • Structured, analytical thinking: you can sketch a decision tree and define the right outcome for edge cases
  • The ability to explain complex topics simply to engineers, customers and decision-makers
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools
  • Motivation to reshape the profession, not just to take the next career step
  • Native or near-native English - German is a plus
  • You are Europe-based

Nice to have

  • Experience in product management, audit methodology or audit tooling/digitisation projects
  • WP/CPA/ACA qualification or working towards one

Benefits

  • Creative freedom: You will be given ownership from day one in a team with flat hierarchies and short decision-making paths. You will have the opportunity to actively shape the development and scaling of the company.
  • First-class team: International and motivated team. Despite many different locations, regular (online) team events take place to celebrate our joint successes.
  • Development opportunities: You have the opportunity to start your career in a fast-growing company as well as in Enterprise SaaS Sales, quickly climbing the first steps on the career ladder.
  • Remote Work: We encourage flexibility by allowing you to work 100 % from home from anywhere within Europe.
  • Attractive conditions: 30 days' vacation, attractive salary package, a monthly voucher and regular online and offline team events.

Apply now and help shape the future of our company!
We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Staff/Senior Software Engineer - Hydris - Golang (d/f/m)
description:
New Challenge

About Us 
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a Germany-based DefenseTech company with offices in Berlin and Munich. We network market-available sensors, effectors, or situational awareness systems into a tactical IoT backbone that reliably provides armed forces and security agencies with cross-domain information superiority — automated, scalable, and cost-efficient.

Our solutions integrate seamlessly into existing defense and maritime infrastructures, delivering fast data fusion and AI-enhanced analytics for robust situational awareness in dynamic environments. We build platform-agnostic systems that enable real interoperability across domains.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll directly impact the technical direction of our orchestration products – Hydris – the coordination engine for sensors and mission systems, and the interoperability API that underpins it. 

You'll work at the layer where heterogeneous real-world systems like radars, AIS receivers, LoRa mesh radios, satellite feeds, and C2 platforms become a single coherent picture. The problems lie in distributed systems, protocols, and data modeling areas. They play out in environments that are bandwidth-constrained, intermittently connected, and operationally unforgiving. 

The role is deeply hands-on, but it expects you to shape what we build and how we build it, not just deliver what's specified.

What you'll do
Core engine development

  • Design and build the systems that power Hydris.
  • Go is your primary language. You should be comfortable reading Rust and TypeScript across the codebase, even if you're not writing in them day-to-day.
  • Own the architecture of a system that must run reliably on edge hardware, in disconnected mesh networks, and at scale — often all of that simultaneously.
Protocol and integration architecture
  • Evolve the schema that defines how every sensor, asset, and mission system talks to Hydris.
  • Make API design decisions that hold up across our client libraries without creating a maintenance burden.
  • Continue refining the integration framework that lets Hydris connect to new sensor types, data sources, and command systems.
  • Set the patterns for how built-in integrations (ADS-B, AIS, ASTERIX, Meshtastic, SpaceTrack, TAK, federation) are structured, tested, and maintained.
  • Make it straightforward for external developers and system vendors to build their own plugins/integrations to Hydris.
Distributed systems
  • Architect the peer-to-peer mesh and federation layer that keeps Hydris operational in disconnected, denied, intermittent, and limited-bandwidth environments.
  • Solve the hard coordination problems: conflict resolution across federated nodes, eventual consistency of entity state, and track correlation across unreliable links.
  • Ensure the system degrades gracefully rather than failing completely when connectivity is lost or constrained.
Technical leadership
  • Set technical standards for the codebase: how we test distributed behavior, how we handle protocol versioning, how we think about backward compatibility in an API-first product.
  • Review code with a focus on long-term maintainability and operational correctness, not just feature completion.
  • Make build-versus-integrate decisions and help the team clearly understand the trade-offs.

You should apply if you
  • Have built and shipped distributed systems that run in production, ideally in environments where reliability matters more than convenience.
  • Are comfortable working across the stack, from Protobuf schema design and systems-level Go, to the TypeScript that puts a map in front of a user.
  • Have well-formed views about API design and protocol evolution, informed by experience maintaining APIs that other people depend on.
  • Can operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy but are adept at collaboration with colleagues toward high-quality technical decisions, at scale.
  • Are interested in contributing to European military, maritime, and critical infrastructure defence systems.
  • Write clearly and communicate architectural decisions in a way that survives beyond the conversation where they were made. 
  • Working language is English. German is not required.
You'd be a great fit with
  • Experience with geospatial systems, sensor fusion, or track management.
  • Familiarity with defense or ISR data standards like CoT/TAK, ASTERIX, SAPIENT, MIL-STD-2525.
  • Background in networking, mesh architectures, or systems designed for contested or degraded communication environments.
  • Experience working on developer-facing open-source infrastructure where adoption depends on the quality of the API and documentation.

We Offer
  • Remote work anywhere in Germany, or hybrid/on-site in Berlin or Munich if you're already based there and prefer an office.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership, a flat structure, and real input into technical direction.
  • Annual €1500 Learning & development budget (available after probation).
  • Bike Leasing and Urban Sports Club membership.
  • 30 days of paid time off.
Note: We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role – candidates must already be eligible to work in Germany.

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

 

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

 

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. As our ICT Outsourcing Manager, you strengthen how lemon.markets manages and governs external technology services, outsourcing arrangements, and third-party risk in a regulated environment. Sitting at the intersection of Technology, Compliance, Operations, and partner governance, this role helps ensure that our provider landscape is transparent, well-documented, risk-based, and operationally under control. You will help turn recurring governance work into reliable operating routines, from assessments and reporting to escalations and evidence gathering. This is a hands-on role with real impact, especially for someone who enjoys creating structure, driving follow-up, and continuously improving operational processes.

  • Have enough technical affinity to understand IT services, security-related topics, incidents, and operational dependencies without needing to be a security engineer.

  • Work in a highly structured and reliable way, with strong follow-up discipline, good judgment, and the ability to keep multiple stakeholders aligned.

  • Communicate confidently in German and English, and enjoy making complex governance topics clear, practical, and actionable.

title: Head of Delivery (w/m/d) | Agenturleitung Operations & Projektsteuerung
description:
Designery ist eine spezialisierte Agentur für Ärzt:innen & Zahnärzt:innen. Wir verbinden hochwertige Gestaltung mit intelligenten IT-Lösungen. Unsere Vision: modernes Marketing mit Wirkung, effizient, individuell und bezahlbar.

Wir sind ein 15-köpfiges Team mit flachen Hierarchien, klarer Vision und smarten Tools. Bei uns zählt dein Input, nicht dein Titel.

Als Head of Delivery verantwortest du unsere gesamte Leistungserbringung: Projektmanagement, Webdesign, Web Support, Social, Search, Foto, Video, Brand & Print. Du führst ein Team von sechs Mitarbeitenden, steuerst unser Freelancer-Netzwerk und trägst die Umsatzverantwortung für den gesamten Delivery-Bereich. Dein Auftrag: dafür sorgen, dass unser Wachstum nicht in Überlastung oder Qualitätsverlust kippt, sondern kontrolliert und wirtschaftlich passiert. Du berichtest direkt an den CEO.

Aufgaben

Umsatz und Wirtschaftlichkeit

  • Du verantwortest das Umsatzziel des Delivery-Bereichs und steuerst es monatlich gegen den Plan
  • Du entscheidest, was intern gemacht und was extern eingekauft wird, und behältst dabei die Marge im Blick
  • Du erkennst unbezahlten Mehraufwand früh und stellst ihn ab, statt ihn zu verwalten

Führung und Entwicklung

  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des Delivery-Teams über alle Gewerke hinweg
  • Du entwickelst Menschen weiter, statt Aufgaben nur zu verteilen: du erkennst, was jemand als Nächstes lernen muss, und sorgst dafür, dass es passiert
  • Regelmäßige Leistungsreviews mit klaren Erwartungen, echtem Feedback und dokumentierten Maßnahmen
  • Du erkennst Unterperformance und strukturelle Engpässe früh und handelst, statt zu hoffen
  • Steuerung und Qualitätssicherung unseres Freelancer-Netzwerks

Delivery-Qualität und Kundenzufriedenheit

  • Gesamtverantwortung dafür, dass Projekte sauber, termingerecht und wirtschaftlich rausgehen
  • Du bist die Eskalationsinstanz bei kritischen Projektabweichungen und entscheidest, statt zu moderieren
  • Systematische Reduktion von Rework, Verzögerungen und Qualitätsmängeln durch klare Standards und Abnahmekriterien

Prozesse und Skalierbarkeit

  • Weiterentwicklung und Effizienz aller Delivery-Prozesse
  • Standardisierung dort, wo sie Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Skalierbarkeit erhöht, und nur dort
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Workinstructions vollständig, aktuell und im Team verbindlich angewendet werden

Ressourcen und Kapazität

  • Gesamtüberblick über Auslastung, Engpässe und Abhängigkeiten
  • Aktives Gegensteuern bei Überlastung und bei Leerlauf
  • Überstunden sind bei uns kein Steuerungsinstrument

Qualifikation

  • Du hast Delivery, Produktion oder Projektmanagement in einer Agentur oder einem Dienstleistungsunternehmen verantwortet
  • Du hast bereits ein Team geführt und weiterentwickelt, fachlich wie persönlich
  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, externe Dienstleister und Freelancer zu steuern, inklusive Qualität und Kosten
  • Du behältst über mehrere Fachdisziplinen den Überblick, ohne in jeder selbst Expert:in zu sein
  • Ein Umsatzziel zu verantworten ist für dich nichts Neues
  • Auslastungs-, Soll-Ist- und Projektmargenrechnungen liest du ohne fremde Hilfe
  • Du entscheidest auch bei unangenehmen Themen und stehst danach dazu
  • Du unterscheidest den Einzelfall vom strukturellen Problem und behandelst beides unterschiedlich
  • Du sagst Sales auch mal Nein, wenn eine Zusage nicht lieferbar ist
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, weil unsere Kund:innen Praxen in Deutschland sind

Benefits

  • Echte Entscheidungsbefugnis: Priorisierung, Prozesse, Ressourcen, Budget. Du entscheidest, du musst nicht überzeugen.
  • Klarer Rahmen: Wir arbeiten nach Scaling Up. Ziele, Rhythmen und Verantwortlichkeiten sind schriftlich definiert, nicht Auslegungssache.
  • Weiterentwicklung, die nicht nur im Vertrag steht: Du bekommst ein eigenes Budget für Fortbildung und Coaching und einen festen Rhythmus, in dem wir über deine Entwicklung sprechen, nicht nur über deine Zahlen.
  • Flexible Urlaubsplanung: Du entscheidest, wann du deine Auszeit brauchst. Denn Erholung ist wichtig.
  • 4-Tage-Woche: Unsere Erfahrung zeigt dass eine Arbeitswoche auch in 4 Tagen gelingt.
  • High-End Technik: MacBook & Co. für produktives Arbeiten, natürlich auch zur privaten Nutzung.
  • Urban-Sports, Jobrad & Co.: Deine Fitness und Mobilität liegen uns am Herzen. Ob Urban Sports, Jobrad oder Deutschlandticket, du hast die freie Wahl.

Danach entscheiden wir, und danach wirst du bei uns bewertet.

Das sind unsere fünf Core Values. Sie stehen nicht zur Dekoration hier, sie sind Teil jedes Feedbacks und jeder Beurteilung.

  • Wir spielen auf Sieg. Jeder kennt seine Zahl und findet selbst den Weg dorthin. Auf Anweisungen warten wir nicht.
  • Wir sind Zuverlässig. Wir haben unsere Themen im Griff. Nicht unsere Ausreden.
  • Wir machen unser Fach besser. Können setzen wir voraus. Profi ist, wer sein Fach weiterbringt, statt es nur zu beherrschen.
  • Zufrieden ist zu wenig. Wir liefern, womit niemand gerechnet hat. Unsere Kund:innen empfehlen uns, ohne dass wir fragen.
  • Wir sagen, was wir denken. Scheinharmonie ist Respektlosigkeit in Zeitlupe. Klarheit ist unsere Form von Wertschätzung.

Wenn dich das eher abschreckt als anzieht, sind wir vermutlich nicht die richtige Adresse. Wenn du beim Lesen genickt hast, sollten wir reden.

So läuft es ab
Express-Bewerbung: Erstes Kennenlernen in 15 Minuten per Video. Schnelle Rückmeldung, wie es weiter geht. Danach folgt ein längeres Gespräch vor Ort und ein Team-Kennenlernen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

description:
Jobbeschreibung

Du hast in deinem jetzigen Job das Gefühl, unter deinen Möglichkeiten zu bleiben? Und du weißt: Wenn du mit Menschen arbeitest, läufst du zur Höchstform auf? Dann brauchst du keinen passenden Lebenslauf – du brauchst nur den Willen, neu anzufangen.

Viele unserer stärksten Leute kommen nicht aus der Personalbranche. Sie haben vorher im Einzelhandel beraten, in der Gastronomie unter Druck funktioniert, im Handwerk Kunden betreut oder am Telefon verkauft. Was sie mitbrachten, war kein Fachwissen, sondern Menschenverstand, Ausdauer und Lust auf Ergebnisse. Das Handwerkliche haben sie bei uns gelernt – und du kannst das auch.

Aramaz Digital ist eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung mitten in Bielefeld. Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, als Arbeitgeber wahrgenommen zu werden und verlässlich passende Bewerbungen zu bekommen. Weil Fachkräfte in fast jeder Branche knapp sind, wächst unser Markt Jahr für Jahr weiter – ein guter Zeitpunkt also, hier einzusteigen.

Warum ein Quereinstieg bei uns funktioniert

  • Wir bilden dich aus, statt dich ins Wasser zu werfen: Du startest mit einem strukturierten Onboarding, bekommst Schulungen zu Akquise, Beratung und Personalgewinnung und hast von Anfang an feste Feedbackgespräche.
  • Du lernst am echten Fall: Statt wochenlanger Theorie arbeitest du früh mit eigenen Kunden – begleitet, aber nicht bevormundet.
  • Der weitere Weg steht fest: Recruiter, danach Junior Consultant, danach Senior Consultant. Wie schnell du diese Stufen nimmst, entscheidest du.
  • Du baust zwei Kompetenzen gleichzeitig auf: Vertrieb und Recruiting. Diese Kombination ist am Arbeitsmarkt selten und macht dich unabhängig.

Das erwartet dich im Alltag

Auf Unternehmensseite

  • Du nimmst Kontakt zu Firmen auf, telefonisch und über direkte Ansprache, und machst sie auf unsere digitalen Recruiting-Lösungen aufmerksam.
  • Du findest heraus, wo bei der Personalsuche der Schuh drückt, und schlägst einen konkreten Weg vor.
  • Du präsentierst deinen Vorschlag und führst das Gespräch bis zur Zusammenarbeit.

Auf Bewerberseite

  • Läuft die Kampagne, steuerst du sie eigenständig – Planung, Beobachtung, Nachjustierung.
  • Du schaust dir die eingehenden Bewerbungen an, führst erste Telefonate und sorgst dafür, dass Kandidaten sich gut behandelt fühlen.
  • Bis die Stelle besetzt ist, bleibt das Projekt bei dir.

Dein Werkzeugkasten

  • Du dokumentierst deine Kontakte im CRM, weißt jederzeit, wo deine Projekte stehen, und arbeitest auf messbare Ziele hin.
  • Du tauschst dich eng mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung aus und sagst, wenn dir etwas auffällt, das besser laufen könnte.

Was du mitbringen solltest

Wichtig ist uns:

  • Du redest gern mit Menschen. Ob am Telefon, im Video-Call oder vor Ort: Der Kontakt zu Fremden macht dir nichts aus.
  • Du gibst nicht beim ersten Nein auf. Absagen gehören dazu, sie sollen dich nicht aus der Bahn werfen.
  • Du fragst nach. Statt vorschnell zu antworten, hörst du erst richtig zu.
  • Du willst mehr als Dienst nach Vorschrift. Und du bist bereit, dafür Neues zu lernen.

Was wir dir dafür bieten

  • Festgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provision: Die Basis ist sicher, nach oben ist offen.
  • Erstklassige Ausstattung: Höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman-Miller-Stühle, Apple-Geräte – im Büro mitten in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.
  • Fitnessvertrag inklusive: Premium-Mitgliedschaft im Studio deiner Wahl, von uns bezahlt.
  • Gute Verpflegung: Siebträgerkaffee von Julius Meinl, ausgesuchte Tees und ein flexibles Mittagsangebot über Meyer Menü.
  • Kurze Wege: Kollegiales Team, leistungsorientiert, direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung.

So bewirbst du dich

  1. Lebenslauf reicht – kein Anschreiben, keine Formalien, zwei Minuten Aufwand.
  2. Wir rufen dich an – innerhalb von 48 Stunden, für ein lockeres erstes Gespräch.
  3. Wir lernen uns kennen – persönlich in unserem Büro in Bielefeld.

Der beste Zeitpunkt für einen Neuanfang ist selten bequem, aber meistens jetzt. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Senior Sales Engineer (m/w/d) in München & Berlin
description:
Über Convercus

Convercus ist eine führende Loyalty- und Couponing-Software Plattform für Enterprise- und Mid-Market-Unternehmen in Europa. Mit unserer Technologie helfen wir Marken dabei, Kundenbeziehungen nachhaltig aufzubauen, Kundenbindung messbar zu steigern und hochperformante Loyalty-Programme zu entwickeln.

Als wachsendes Scale-up verbinden wir die Dynamik eines Start-ups mit der Professionalität eines Enterprise-Software-Anbieters. Wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Chancen erkennen und ihren Bereich aktiv gestalten wollen – nicht auf Anweisungen warten.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

Als Senior Sales Engineer bist du der technische und fachliche Sparringspartner unserer Enterprise-Kunden während des gesamten Verkaufsprozesses. Du überzeugst Enterprise-Kunden zusammen mit den Teams Vertrieb, Produkt und Customer Success von unserer Plattform.

Du verstehst die geschäftlichen Herausforderungen unserer Interessenten, übersetzt Anforderungen in überzeugende Lösungsansätze und zeigst, wie Convercus konkrete Business-Ergebnisse erzielt.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Enterprise Sales Team, Customer Success und Product Management zusammen und beeinflusst durch Kundenfeedback aktiv die Weiterentwicklung unserer Plattform.

Deine Aufgaben

Enterprise Pre-Sales & Solution Consulting

  • Unterstützung des Enterprise Sales Teams bei komplexen und strategischen Verkaufsprozessen
  • Durchführung von Discovery Workshops zur Analyse von Geschäftsanforderungen, Pain Points und Erfolgskennzahlen
  • Entwicklung maßgeschneiderter Lösung sansätze und Business Cases für Enterprise-Kunden
  • Übersetzung technischer Funktionen in konkrete Business Outcomes für Fach- und Managementbereiche

Produktdemos & Workshops

  • Durchführung von überzeugenden Produktdemonstrationen für unterschiedliche Stakeholder – von Marketing-Teams bis hin zu C-Level-Entscheidern
  • Moderation von Workshops, Enablement Sessions und Lösungspräsentationen
  • Entwicklung von Demo-Szenarien entlang realer Kundenanforderungen

Solution Design & Technical Validation

  • Beratung zu Integrationen, Systemarchitekturen und technischen Umsetzungsmodellen
  • Unterstützung bei RFPs, Ausschreibungen und Sicherheitsanforderungen
  • Begleitung von Proof of Concepts (PoCs) und Pilotprojekten
  • Definition von Erfolgskriterien und Sicherstellung des technischen Sales-Wins

Zusammenarbeit mit Product & Customer Success

  • Einbringen von Markt- und Kundenfeedback in die Produkt-Roadmap
  • Erkennen von Markttrends und Einbringen strategischer Impulse in das Produktboard
  • Unterstützung reibungsloser Übergaben vom Vertrieb in die Implementierung
  • Entwicklung von Best Practices, Präsentationen und Sales-Enablement-Materialien

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

Fachliche Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung als Sales Engineer, Solutions Consultant, Presales Consultant oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Enterprise-SaaS-Umfeld
  • Erfahrung in komplexen B2B-Verkaufsprozessen mit mehreren Entscheidungsträgern
  • Verständnis von SaaS-, API-, Integrations- und Plattformarchitekturen
  • Erfahrung mit technischen Discovery-Prozessen und Lösungsdesign
  • Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von Ausschreibungen und Enterprise-Evaluierungen

Business-Verständnis statt Feature-Pitching

Du verstehst nicht nur Software, sondern auch Geschäftsmodelle, Prozesse und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge.

Exzellente Kommunikation

Du kannst komplexe technische Themen verständlich erklären – sowohl gegenüber Entwicklern als auch gegenüber Vorständen.

Ownership

Du übernimmst Verantwortung, denkst unternehmerisch und bringst Themen aktiv voran.

Kundenorientierung

Du begeisterst Kunden durch Fachwissen, Professionalität und den echten Willen, Probleme zu lösen.

Zusammenarbeit

Du arbeitest gerne bereichsübergreifend und verstehst dich als Brücke zwischen Vertrieb, Product und Customer Success.

  • Retail-, Travel- oder Hospitality-Branchen
  • Marketing Automation Plattformen
  • Datenintegrationen und API-basierten Architekturen
  • Cloud-basierten SaaS-Landschaften

Benefits

Warum Convercus?

Echten Impact schaffen

Wir glauben, dass großartige Ergebnisse entstehen, wenn Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen. Bei Convercus bekommst du den Freiraum, deinen Bereich aktiv zu gestalten, Entscheidungen zu treffen und sichtbaren Einfluss auf den Unternehmenserfolg zu haben.

Wachstum mitgestalten

Du wirst Teil eines Scale-ups, das sich in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase befindet. Deine Ideen, Erfahrungen und Initiativen machen einen echten Unterschied.

Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe

Wir arbeiten eng über Teamgrenzen hinweg zusammen. Sales, Customer Success und Product ziehen gemeinsam an einem Strang, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden zu erzielen.

Moderne Technologie

Du arbeitest mit modernen SaaS- und AI-Tools und verkaufst eine Lösung, die bei führenden Unternehmen einen direkten messbaren Business Impact erzeugt.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf zu erfahren, wie du gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft von Loyalty, Customer Engagement und Enterprise Commerce gestalten wirst.
